entries.english: Manage Bitwarden and Vaultwarden vaults via the bw CLI: search, create, edit and organize logins, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys, folders and Sends.
entries.zh: 通过 bw CLI 管理 Bitwarden 和 Vaultwarden 保险库：搜索、创建、编辑和整理登录信息、笔记、卡片、身份、SSH 密钥、文件夹和 Send。

entries.english: Scans dependency lockfiles for vulnerabilities, prioritizes them by EPSS exploit probability and recommends fix versions, with monitoring and alerting.
entries.zh: 扫描依赖锁文件中的漏洞，按 EPSS 漏洞利用概率确定优先级并推荐修复版本，支持监控和警报。

entries.english: Scan ML model artifacts, URLs and directories for unsafe serialization, malicious patterns and risky packaging using ModelScan, PickleScan and heuristics.
entries.zh: 使用 ModelScan、PickleScan 和启发式方法扫描机器学习模型产物、URL 和目录，查找不安全序列化、恶意模式及高风险打包。

entries.english: Audits agents and MCP servers for prompt injection, infinite loops, token bombing and missing human oversight, with EU AI Act and OWASP mapping.
entries.zh: 审计代理和 MCP 服务器中的提示注入、无限循环、令牌轰炸和缺乏人工监督等问题，并映射欧盟 AI 法案和 OWASP。

entries.english: Self-hosted default-deny action registry, append-only spend-intent ledger and human sign-off audit trail for gating irreversible agent actions.
entries.zh: 自托管的默认拒绝操作注册表、仅追加的支出意图账本和人工签核审计记录，用于控制代理的不可逆操作。

entries.english: Read, write and scan the memory of running processes, Cheat Engine style: value scans that narrow down as the value changes, pointer chains, and scan results kept server-side behind a handle.
entries.zh: 以 Cheat Engine 风格读取、写入和扫描运行中进程的内存：值扫描会随值变化缩小范围，支持指针链，扫描结果通过句柄保留在服务器端。

entries.english: Agent security middleware with layered defenses: prompt injection detection, DLP data flow tracking, command blocking and PII detection.
entries.zh: 提供分层防御的代理安全中间件：提示注入检测、DLP 数据流跟踪、命令阻止和个人身份信息检测。

entries.english: Action logs for AI agents: records every action in a SHA-256 hash chain as an audit trail.
entries.zh: AI 代理操作日志：将每次操作记录在 SHA-256 哈希链中，形成审计记录。

entries.english: Microsoft Patch Tuesday triage from the MSRC Security Update Guide: monthly rollups, CVE/KB lookups, supersedence chains and EPSS/CISA KEV urgency ranking.
entries.zh: 基于 MSRC Security Update Guide 对微软每月补丁星期二进行分诊：月度汇总、CVE/KB 查询、替代关系链及 EPSS/CISA KEV 紧急程度排序。

entries.english: Retrieve live and recorded video from a CCTV recording program (VMS) and control it, such as opening live or playback dialogs for specific channels and times.
entries.zh: 从 CCTV 录像程序（VMS）获取实时和录制视频并进行控制，例如为指定频道和时间打开实时或回放对话框。

entries.english: Encrypted secrets vault for Claude Code that injects secrets into local files so the AI never sees raw values, with audit logs and per-model access rules.
entries.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的加密密钥库，将密钥注入本地文件，使 AI 无法看到原始值，并提供审计日志及按模型设置的访问规则。

entries.english: Local stdio server for Gooo-generated service-grant narrowing decisions: checks preservation of one required request and returns the full proof with source/generation bindings. It does not apply grants or authenticate supplied facts.
entries.zh: 用于 Gooo 生成的服务授权收窄决策的本地 stdio 服务器：检查一项必需请求是否得到保留，并返回含来源/生成绑定的完整证明。它不应用授权，也不认证所提供的事实。

entries.english: Autonomous reverse engineering with Ghidra: decompile binaries, rename methods and data, and list methods, classes, imports and exports.
entries.zh: 使用 Ghidra 进行自主逆向工程：反编译二进制文件，重命名方法和数据，列出方法、类、导入和导出。

entries.english: Attack-path engine for cloud and Kubernetes: list routes from internet exposure to sensitive assets, explain each hop, find choke points and simulate fixes.
entries.zh: 面向云和 Kubernetes 的攻击路径引擎：列出从互联网暴露点到敏感资产的路径，解释各跳、查找关键瓶颈并模拟修复。

entries.english: Accountability for AI agent fleets: verify a signed, hash-chained ledger, check budgets, kill an agent, and issue passports and mandates, all through the local CLI.
entries.zh: AI 代理集群问责：通过本地 CLI 验证签名哈希链账本、检查预算、终止代理并签发护照和授权委任。

entries.english: Honeypot framework for building decoy MCP tools that an agent would never use in normal work, to detect prompt injection and malicious agent behavior.
entries.zh: 蜜罐框架，用于构建代理在正常工作中绝不会使用的诱饵 MCP 工具，以检测提示注入和恶意代理行为。

entries.english: Mobb Vibe Shield identifies and remediates vulnerabilities in human and AI-written code.
entries.zh: Mobb Vibe Shield 识别并修复人类和 AI 编写代码中的漏洞。

entries.english: Trust infrastructure for AI agents: register DIDs, verify identities, query reputation scores, rate agents and manage W3C Verifiable Credentials.
entries.zh: AI 代理信任基础设施：注册 DID、验证身份、查询信誉评分、评价代理并管理 W3C 可验证凭证。

entries.english: AI supply chain security scanner: discovers MCP clients, scans dependencies for CVEs, maps blast radius to credentials and tools, and generates SBOMs.
entries.zh: AI 供应链安全扫描器：发现 MCP 客户端、扫描依赖中的 CVE、将影响范围映射到凭据和工具，并生成 SBOM。

entries.english: IDA Pro plugin for binary analysis: decompilation, disassembly and automatic malware analysis reports.
entries.zh: 用于二进制分析的 IDA Pro 插件：反编译、反汇编和自动恶意软件分析报告。

entries.english: Administer Keycloak via its Admin REST API: users, roles, clients, groups, identity providers, federation and events, with a read-only mode.
entries.zh: 通过 Keycloak Admin REST API 管理用户、角色、客户端、群组、身份提供商、联合身份和事件，并提供只读模式。

entries.english: Pre-install security scanner for MCP servers: detects backdoors, exfiltration code, obfuscation, dangerous execution, prompt injection and supply chain risks.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器安装前安全扫描器：检测后门、数据外传代码、混淆、危险执行、提示注入和供应链风险。

entries.english: SecObserve vulnerability and license management: triage observations, manage products and rules, import scan reports and SBOMs, run scans and generate VEX.
entries.zh: SecObserve 漏洞与许可证管理：分诊观察结果、管理产品和规则、导入扫描报告及 SBOM、运行扫描并生成 VEX。

entries.english: Static security scanner for MCP servers and agent tools: detects secrets, shell execution, risky tool descriptions, environment access and prompt injection.
entries.zh: 用于 MCP 服务器和代理工具的静态安全扫描器：检测密钥、shell 执行、高风险工具说明、环境访问和提示注入。

entries.english: Offline, read-only audit of MCP client configs: flags plain HTTP, shell wrappers, unpinned runners, embedded credentials and broad access scopes; outputs redacted text, JSON or SARIF.
entries.zh: 离线只读审计 MCP 客户端配置：标记明文 HTTP、shell 包装器、未固定版本的运行器、嵌入凭据和过宽访问范围；输出脱敏文本、JSON 或 SARIF。

entries.english: Permission tiers, approval gates and secret-redacting audit logging enforced inside MCP servers at the tool boundary, with a demo order-desk server.
entries.zh: 在 MCP 服务器的工具边界内强制执行权限分级、审批关卡和密钥脱敏审计日志，并提供订单服务台演示服务器。

entries.english: Privacy boundary for healthcare AI agents: pseudonymises patient identifiers (NHS numbers, names, dates of birth, addresses; UK and US) into labelled tokens locally, keeps the reversal map out of agent context, and restores originals only at the trusted boundary.
entries.zh: 面向医疗 AI 代理的隐私边界：在本地将患者标识符（英国及美国的 NHS 号码、姓名、出生日期、地址）假名化为带标签的令牌，将反向映射保留在代理上下文之外，仅在可信边界恢复原值。

entries.english: Conversational recon with httpx and asnmap: domain analysis, security header inspection, certificate analysis and ASN lookups at multiple recon levels.
entries.zh: 使用 httpx 和 asnmap 进行对话式侦察：在多个侦察级别分析域名、检查安全标头、分析证书并查询 ASN。

entries.english: Security testing tools for penetration testing, network forensics, memory analysis and vulnerability assessment.
entries.zh: 用于渗透测试、网络取证、内存分析和漏洞评估的安全测试工具。

entries.english: OPA and Rego policy toolkit wrapping the OPA CLI and Regal: format, lint, evaluate, test and benchmark policies, manage the OPA REST API and explain decisions.
entries.zh: 封装 OPA CLI 和 Regal 的 OPA 与 Rego 策略工具集：格式化、检查、评估、测试和基准测试策略，管理 OPA REST API 并解释决策。

entries.english: Generate, audit, fix and compile smart contracts on Ethereum, Solana, Base and other chains, with adversarial multi-agent pen testing and honeypot detection.
entries.zh: 在 Ethereum、Solana、Base 等链上生成、审计、修复和编译智能合约，并提供对抗性多代理渗透测试和蜜罐检测。

entries.english: Transparent proxy that intercepts, signs, rate-limits, redacts and audits MCP tool calls without modifying client or server.
entries.zh: 透明代理，无需修改客户端或服务器即可拦截、签名、限流、脱敏和审计 MCP 工具调用。

entries.english: Use Panther's SIEM platform in natural language to write detections, query logs and manage alerts.
entries.zh: 使用自然语言操作 Panther SIEM 平台，编写检测规则、查询日志和管理警报。

entries.english: Pin MCP tool contracts by hash and catch silent drift, rug pulls and per-client bait-and-switch after approval, with a CI gate, live stdio/HTTP proxies, canary replay, call policies and on-chain release verification.
entries.zh: 以哈希固定 MCP 工具契约，在批准后捕获静默漂移、恶意撤换和针对不同客户端的诱骗替换，提供 CI 关卡、实时 stdio/HTTP 代理、金丝雀重放、调用策略和链上发布验证。

entries.english: Audit the MCP servers you use against the OWASP MCP Top 10: tool poisoning, rug pulls, shadowing, secrets and supply-chain risk, with runtime guards, approved-server policy and adversarial testing for server authors.
entries.zh: 对照 OWASP MCP Top 10 审计所用 MCP 服务器：工具投毒、恶意撤换、工具遮蔽、密钥及供应链风险，提供运行时防护、已批准服务器策略和面向服务器作者的对抗测试。

entries.english: Supply chain risk scoring for npm, PyPI, Cargo and Go packages from behavioral signals: publisher depth, release consistency and maintenance patterns.
entries.zh: 根据行为信号为 npm、PyPI、Cargo 和 Go 包评分供应链风险，涵盖发布者背景、发布一致性和维护模式。

entries.english: Static and dynamic analysis of Android and iOS apps with MobSF.
entries.zh: 使用 MobSF 对 Android 和 iOS 应用进行静态和动态分析。

entries.english: Read-only MISP threat intelligence (events, attributes, search, tags, feeds, galaxies) with prompt injection scanning of every response.
entries.zh: 只读 MISP 威胁情报（事件、属性、搜索、标签、订阅源、星系），并对每条响应进行提示注入扫描。

entries.english: Privacy and approval gateway between AI assistants and Gmail, Drive, Slack, Salesforce, Jira and more: human approval for sensitive reads and writes, local PII detection and an audit log.
entries.zh: 位于 AI 助手与 Gmail、Drive、Slack、Salesforce、Jira 等服务之间的隐私和审批网关：敏感读写需人工批准，支持本地个人身份信息检测和审计日志。

entries.english: Deterministic security scan of public git repositories: vulnerable dependencies via OSV, hard-coded secrets and risky config lint, as file:line findings.
entries.zh: 对公开 git 仓库进行确定性安全扫描：通过 OSV 检测易受攻击的依赖，检查硬编码密钥及高风险配置，并以 file:line 形式报告。

entries.english: Verify agent communication protocols with session types and Lean 4 proofs to catch deadlocks and role violations; includes a linter, formatter and LSP.
entries.zh: 使用会话类型和 Lean 4 证明验证代理通信协议，发现死锁和角色违规；包含检查器、格式化工具和 LSP。

entries.english: Query the RAD Security API for Kubernetes and cloud security findings, reports and runtime data.
entries.zh: 查询 RAD Security API，获取 Kubernetes 和云安全发现、报告及运行时数据。

entries.english: Disassemble and inspect binaries for reverse engineering with the Radare2 disassembler.
entries.zh: 使用 Radare2 反汇编器反汇编和检查二进制文件，以进行逆向工程。

entries.english: Runs 12 OSINT tools locally (Sherlock, Maigret, Holehe, GHunt, SpiderFoot, subfinder...) plus built-in WHOIS, DNS, crt.sh and Wayback lookups. No API keys.
entries.zh: 在本地运行 12 个 OSINT 工具（Sherlock、Maigret、Holehe、GHunt、SpiderFoot、subfinder 等），并内置 WHOIS、DNS、crt.sh 和 Wayback 查询。无需 API 密钥。

entries.english: Static C/C++ memory-safety scanning and PE/ELF binary protection audits (ASLR, DEP/NX, SafeSEH, PIE), with remediation via secure templates.
entries.zh: 静态扫描 C/C++ 内存安全问题并审计 PE/ELF 二进制保护（ASLR、DEP/NX、SafeSEH、PIE），通过安全模板提供修复。

entries.english: Stateless privacy shield, WebMCP semantic firewall, and gasless on-chain state settlement for autonomous AI agents on Midnight Network.
entries.zh: 面向 Midnight Network 上自主 AI 代理的无状态隐私屏障、WebMCP 语义防火墙和免 gas 链上状态结算。

entries.english: Fail-closed policy-as-code proxy for MCP that denies risky tool calls, produces offline-verifiable evidence bundles and enforces egress via eBPF and Landlock.
entries.zh: 默认拒绝的 MCP 策略即代码代理，拒绝高风险工具调用、生成可离线验证的证据包，并通过 eBPF 和 Landlock 强制执行出站访问控制。

entries.english: Locally check npm and PyPI packages, such as those suggested by AI coding tools, for vulnerabilities and malicious code.
entries.zh: 在本地检查 npm 和 PyPI 包（例如 AI 编程工具建议的包）是否存在漏洞和恶意代码。

entries.english: Enumerate AWS IAM data, analyze effective permissions and visualize access relationships across users, roles and resources, based on dAWShund.
entries.zh: 基于 dAWShund 枚举 AWS IAM 数据、分析有效权限，并可视化用户、角色和资源之间的访问关系。

entries.english: Thales CipherTrust Manager integration for key management, cryptographic operations and compliance monitoring.
entries.zh: 集成 Thales CipherTrust Manager，提供密钥管理、加密操作和合规监控。

entries.english: Thales CDSP CAKM integration for key management, cryptographic operations and compliance monitoring for Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle databases.
entries.zh: 集成 Thales CDSP CAKM，为 Microsoft SQL Server 和 Oracle 数据库提供密钥管理、加密操作和合规监控。

entries.english: Integration with the Thales CipherTrust Manager RESTful Data Protection service.
entries.zh: 与 Thales CipherTrust Manager RESTful Data Protection 服务集成。

entries.english: Signed audit chain for AI agent decisions: events are signed, Merkle-chained per project, anchored to public transparency logs and verifiable offline.
entries.zh: AI 代理决策的签名审计链：事件经签名、按项目组成 Merkle 链、锚定到公开透明日志，并可离线验证。

entries.english: Scam and threat checks for phone numbers, URLs, texts, emails, documents and QR codes using FTC/FCC complaints, URLhaus and ThreatFox, with risk scores.
entries.zh: 使用 FTC/FCC 投诉、URLhaus 和 ThreatFox 检查电话号码、URL、文本、邮件、文档和二维码的诈骗与威胁，并提供风险评分。

entries.english: Manage Scalekit organizations, users and SSO.
entries.zh: 管理 Scalekit 组织、用户和单点登录。

entries.english: Security trust layer that monitors MCP packages on npm for install scripts, command injection, hardcoded secrets, capability drift and publisher posture.
entries.zh: 安全信任层，监控 npm 上的 MCP 包，检查安装脚本、命令注入、硬编码密钥、能力漂移和发布者安全状况。

entries.english: Algenta decision engine: dataset discovery, exact queries, utility models, decision memory and governed agent runs with approvals and execution receipts.
entries.zh: Algenta 决策引擎：数据集发现、精确查询、效用模型、决策记忆以及带审批和执行凭据的受治理代理运行。

entries.english: Security gateway that wraps MCP servers with per-tool policies, approval gates and optional signed receipts, in shadow (log-only) or enforce mode.
entries.zh: 包装 MCP 服务器的安全网关，提供按工具设置的策略、审批关卡和可选签名凭据，支持影子模式（仅记录）或强制模式。

entries.english: Enterprise security and code-safety guardrail for AI agents featuring AST taint analysis, SARIF/SBOM generation, and policy gates.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的企业安全和代码安全防护，提供 AST 污点分析、SARIF/SBOM 生成和策略关卡。

entries.english: Security testing toolbox that combines open source tools behind a single interface for pentesting, bug bounty hunting and threat hunting.
entries.zh: 将开源工具整合到单一界面的安全测试工具箱，用于渗透测试、漏洞赏金和威胁狩猎。

entries.english: Self-hostable human-in-the-loop approval inbox: humans approve, reject or edit proposed agent actions via web, mobile, Slack, Discord or Telegram.
entries.zh: 可自托管的人参与审批收件箱：人工通过网页、移动端、Slack、Discord 或 Telegram 批准、拒绝或编辑代理提议的操作。

entries.english: Scan code for security vulnerabilities using Semgrep.
entries.zh: 使用 Semgrep 扫描代码中的安全漏洞。

entries.english: Local credential gateway for coding agents: agents get handles instead of raw secrets, and one-time approvals inject credentials only into approved commands.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地凭据网关：代理获得句柄而非原始密钥，一次性批准仅向已批准命令注入凭据。

entries.english: Scan SKILL.md files, MCP configs and system prompts for credential theft, prompt injection, zero-width character attacks and ClawHavoc indicators.
entries.zh: 扫描 SKILL.md 文件、MCP 配置和系统提示词，检测凭据窃取、提示注入、零宽字符攻击和 ClawHavoc 指标。

entries.english: Use CyberChef operations through the CyberChef server API.
entries.zh: 通过 CyberChef 服务器 API 使用 CyberChef 操作。

entries.english: Governance proxy that wraps MCP servers with policy evaluation, human approval workflows and hash-chain audit trails.
entries.zh: 包装 MCP 服务器的治理代理，提供策略评估、人工审批工作流和哈希链审计记录。

entries.english: Solana token safety oracle: byte-level SPL mint analysis, honeypot detection, freeze/mint authority checks, Birdeye market data and composite risk scoring.
entries.zh: Solana 代币安全预言机：字节级 SPL 铸币分析、蜜罐检测、冻结/铸币权限检查、Birdeye 市场数据和综合风险评分。

entries.english: MCP governance proxy with capability tokens, tiered approvals, fail-closed execution and tamper-evident audit receipts, plus preflight tool-risk scanning.
entries.zh: MCP 治理代理，提供能力令牌、分级审批、默认拒绝执行和防篡改审计凭据，并在调用前扫描工具风险。

entries.english: SAST/DAST scanners (Bandit, Semgrep, Trivy, CodeQL, OWASP ZAP and more) with closed-loop remediation, SARIF/SBOM/VEX export and compliance reporting.
entries.zh: SAST/DAST 扫描器（Bandit、Semgrep、Trivy、CodeQL、OWASP ZAP 等），支持闭环修复、SARIF/SBOM/VEX 导出和合规报告。

entries.english: Embeds Snyk's security engines into agentic workflows to secure AI-generated code in real time and work through vulnerability backlogs faster.
entries.zh: 将 Snyk 安全引擎嵌入代理工作流，实时保护 AI 生成代码并加快处理积压漏洞。

entries.english: Fail-closed policy proxy for MCP tool calls that denies, warns on or holds each call for human approval before forwarding, with client-side redaction.
entries.zh: 面向 MCP 工具调用的默认拒绝策略代理，在转发前拒绝、警告或暂停每次调用以待人工批准，并支持客户端脱敏。

entries.english: Query the OSV (Open Source Vulnerabilities) database by package version or commit, batch-query multiple packages and get vulnerability details by ID.
entries.zh: 按包版本或提交查询 OSV（开源漏洞）数据库、批量查询多个包，并按 ID 获取漏洞详情。

entries.english: Read-only checks before an agent acts: prompt-injection and phishing scan of untrusted text (local), npm package check for malware, hijacked releases and typosquats, crypto address and token scan, and address-poisoning comparison. Zero dependencies.
entries.zh: 代理行动前的只读检查：本地扫描不受信任文本中的提示注入和钓鱼内容，检查 npm 包中的恶意软件、被劫持发布及拼写抢注，扫描加密地址和代币，并比较地址投毒。零依赖。

entries.english: Classify input for prompt injection and out-of-scope content with Koma Gate's LLM-based classifier.
entries.zh: 使用 Koma Gate 基于大语言模型的分类器，识别输入中的提示注入和超范围内容。

entries.english: Local security scanner for AI-generated JS/TS that combines Opengrep, Gitleaks and Trivy with checks for exposed secrets, Supabase RLS and prompt injection.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 生成的 JS/TS 的本地安全扫描器，结合 Opengrep、Gitleaks 和 Trivy，检查暴露密钥、Supabase RLS 和提示注入。

entries.english: Search the Russian software registry for import-substitution and FSTEC/FSB-certified products, with full-text search and manufacturer listings.
entries.zh: 搜索俄罗斯软件注册表中用于进口替代以及获得 FSTEC/FSB 认证的产品，提供全文搜索和制造商列表。

entries.english: Manage and interact with the OPNsense open source firewall in natural language.
entries.zh: 使用自然语言管理和操作 OPNsense 开源防火墙。

entries.english: Deterministic pre-execution filter for agent tool calls that blocks scope creep (credential reads, SSRF, destructive shell/SQL) and prompt injection.
entries.zh: 针对代理工具调用的确定性执行前过滤器，阻止范围蔓延（凭据读取、SSRF、破坏性 shell/SQL）及提示注入。

entries.english: Admission control for agent file edits: checks syntax, structural-cost regressions and workspace boundaries, returning BLOCK, WARN or PASS verdicts.
entries.zh: 代理文件编辑准入控制：检查语法、结构成本回归和工作区边界，返回 BLOCK、WARN 或 PASS 判定。

entries.english: Read-only AWS audit scanner: public S3 buckets, root and user MFA gaps, unused access keys, world-open security groups, CloudTrail gaps, and forgotten EC2/EBS/RDS spend across every region. Only makes Describe/List/Get calls and runs locally with your own credentials.
entries.zh: 只读 AWS 审计扫描器：检查公开 S3 存储桶、root 和用户 MFA 缺口、未使用访问密钥、对所有人开放的安全组、CloudTrail 缺口，以及各区域被遗忘的 EC2/EBS/RDS 支出。仅调用 Describe/List/Get，并使用自己的凭据在本地运行。

entries.english: Pre-connect supply-chain trust checks for AI agents, frameworks and MCP servers: evidence-based HVTrust scores and verdicts from public signals (package provenance, OSSF Scorecard, signed commits, advisories), plus `scan_stack` to check a whole requirements.txt, package.json or MCP client config at once.
entries.zh: AI 代理、框架和 MCP 服务器连接前的供应链信任检查：根据公开信号（包来源、OSSF Scorecard、签名提交、安全公告）给出有证据的 HVTrust 评分和判定，并提供 `scan_stack` 一次检查整个 requirements.txt、package.json 或 MCP 客户端配置。

entries.english: Headless IDA Pro binary analysis with concurrent sessions and Il2CppDumper and Blutter metadata import for Unity and Flutter reverse engineering.
entries.zh: 无头 IDA Pro 二进制分析，支持并发会话和 Il2CppDumper、Blutter 元数据导入，用于 Unity 和 Flutter 逆向工程。

entries.english: Middleware that gates MCP tool calls behind a Hashcash proof-of-work challenge or an L402 Lightning payment via self-hosted LNbits.
entries.zh: 中间件，通过 Hashcash 工作量证明挑战或自托管 LNbits 的 L402 闪电网络支付控制 MCP 工具调用。

entries.english: Automate reverse engineering of Android APKs with Apktool.
entries.zh: 使用 Apktool 自动逆向分析 Android APK。

entries.english: Zitadel identity management: manage users, projects, OIDC apps, roles and service accounts in natural language.
entries.zh: Zitadel 身份管理：通过自然语言管理用户、项目、OIDC 应用、角色和服务账户。

entries.english: Enforces rules from existing agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules) by blocking prohibited tool calls and logging per-rule compliance verdicts.
entries.zh: 通过阻止被禁止的工具调用并记录逐规则合规判定，强制执行现有代理指令文件（CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules）中的规则。

entries.english: Visual CVE audit dashboard for npm, Python, Go and Rust using OSV data, with browser-based human review and fixes applied only after confirmation.
entries.zh: 基于 OSV 数据的 npm、Python、Go 和 Rust 可视化 CVE 审计仪表盘，通过浏览器进行人工审查，仅在确认后应用修复。

entries.english: Offline verification of Ed25519/JCS-signed artifacts such as receipts, manifests and audit bundles.
entries.zh: 离线验证使用 Ed25519/JCS 签名的产物，如凭据、清单和审计包。

entries.english: JADX decompiler plugin providing live, LLM-assisted reverse engineering.
entries.zh: JADX 反编译器插件，提供实时大语言模型辅助逆向工程。

entries.english: Auth proxy for MCP servers: OAuth2 with DCR, JWT, RBAC, rate limiting, multi-server aggregation and a monitoring dashboard.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器认证代理：支持带 DCR 的 OAuth2、JWT、RBAC、限流、多服务器聚合和监控仪表盘。

entries.english: Ed25519-signed consent receipts and a policy engine for agents: spending caps, action allowlists, escalation thresholds and JWKS-backed provider verification.
entries.zh: 面向代理的 Ed25519 签名同意凭据和策略引擎：支出上限、操作允许列表、升级阈值和基于 JWKS 的提供商验证。

entries.english: Automate cybersecurity assessment of documents, questionnaires and reports to surface risks, compliance gaps and remediations, using a RAG knowledge base.
entries.zh: 利用 RAG 知识库自动开展文档、问卷和报告的网络安全评估，发现风险、合规缺口及修复措施。

entries.english: URL scanning and phishing triage: capture DOM snapshots, network requests and screenshots, and hunt historical scans with a custom query language.
entries.zh: URL 扫描与钓鱼分诊：捕获 DOM 快照、网络请求和截图，并使用自定义查询语言搜索历史扫描。

entries.english: Regulated-industry AI compliance knowledge: control lookup, use-case classification and crosswalks for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, APRA, GDPR and more.
entries.zh: 受监管行业的 AI 合规知识：控制项查询、用例分类及欧盟 AI 法案、NIST AI RMF、ISO 42001、APRA、GDPR 等标准映射。

entries.english: Burn-after-read encrypted Volta Notes for agents: hand off credentials between users and agents without secrets appearing in chat history.
entries.zh: 面向代理的阅后即焚加密 Volta Notes：在用户和代理之间交接凭据，避免密钥出现在聊天历史中。

entries.english: Generate zero-knowledge proofs of identity claims (Coinbase KYC, country, Google OIDC, Microsoft 365) without revealing personal information.
entries.zh: 为身份声明（Coinbase KYC、国家、Google OIDC、Microsoft 365）生成零知识证明，而不泄露个人信息。

entries.english: Injects a live, reversible MCP server into a running Express, FastAPI or Next.js app, with safe reads by default and writes gated behind human confirmation.
entries.zh: 向运行中的 Express、FastAPI 或 Next.js 应用注入实时可撤销的 MCP 服务器，默认安全读取，写入需经人工确认。

entries.english: Package intelligence across many ecosystems: health, vulnerabilities (OSV, CISA KEV, EPSS), typosquats, malicious packages, alternatives and breaking changes.
entries.zh: 跨多种生态系统的包情报：健康状况、漏洞（OSV、CISA KEV、EPSS）、拼写抢注、恶意包、替代方案和破坏性变更。

entries.english: Code property graph for C, Python and TypeScript: callers/callees, data and taint flow with source-to-sink witnesses, points-to and guard/sink structure.
entries.zh: 面向 C、Python 和 TypeScript 的代码属性图：调用方/被调用方、带源到汇证据的数据流和污点流、指向关系以及防护/汇点结构。

entries.english: Security intelligence: CVE/EPSS/KEV lookups, domain recon (DNS, WHOIS, SSL, subdomains), IOC threat intel, OSINT and code scanning for secrets and injection.
entries.zh: 安全情报：CVE/EPSS/KEV 查询、域名侦察（DNS、WHOIS、SSL、子域名）、IOC 威胁情报、OSINT，以及扫描代码中的密钥和注入问题。

entries.english: Share end-to-end encrypted, self-destructing secrets from an agent, reading them from env vars or files so they stay out of LLM context.
entries.zh: 让代理分享端到端加密且自毁的密钥，从环境变量或文件读取，使其不进入大语言模型上下文。

entries.english: Pre-install npm package checks: static analysis, supply-chain attack detection, vulnerability audits, AI hallucination guard and CycloneDX SBOM generation.
entries.zh: npm 包安装前检查：静态分析、供应链攻击检测、漏洞审计、AI 幻觉防护和 CycloneDX SBOM 生成。

entries.english: PCI DSS static analysis for Go payment code: finds PAN/CVV exposure, weak crypto, missing audit logs and vulnerable deps, each mapped to a PCI requirement.
entries.zh: 面向 Go 支付代码的 PCI DSS 静态分析：发现 PAN/CVV 暴露、弱加密、缺失审计日志和易受攻击的依赖，并逐项映射 PCI 要求。

entries.english: Mint, resolve, audit and rotate expiring, scope-limited access links (qURLs) via the qURL API.
entries.zh: 通过 qURL API 创建、解析、审计和轮换有期限及范围限制的访问链接（qURL）。

entries.english: Read-only VMware vSphere compliance scanning and drift detection against CIS, vSphere SCG, China DJCP 2.0 and PCI-DSS, with remediation suggestions.
entries.zh: 对照 CIS、vSphere SCG、中国等保 2.0 和 PCI-DSS，对 VMware vSphere 进行只读合规扫描和漂移检测，并提供修复建议。

entries.english: Write, validate and convert Sigma detection rules for Splunk, Elastic, Kibana and Wazuh, backed by a rule corpus covering MITRE ATT&CK tactics.
entries.zh: 编写、检查、验证并转换供 Splunk、Elastic、Kibana 和 Wazuh 使用的 Sigma 检测规则，使用覆盖 MITRE ATT&CK 战术的规则语料库。

entries.english: Scores MCP servers, AI skills and npm packages before install, scanning for prompt injection, credential theft and supply-chain risk, with a go/no-go gate.
entries.zh: 在安装前对 MCP 服务器、AI 技能和 npm 包评分，扫描提示注入、凭据窃取及供应链风险，并设置允许/禁止关卡。

entries.english: Local macOS scanner for secrets leaked into AI tool chat transcripts, with redacted findings, placeholder-only redaction and Keychain-backed command execution.
entries.zh: 本地 macOS 扫描器，查找泄漏到 AI 工具聊天记录中的密钥，提供脱敏发现、仅替换为占位符的脱敏及由 Keychain 支持的命令执行。

entries.english: Local privacy testing for AI agents: scan code for PII and secrets, score execution traces across internal channels, redact text, and track new or fixed findings through MCP tools.
entries.zh: AI 代理本地隐私测试：扫描代码中的个人身份信息和密钥，跨内部通道对执行跟踪评分、脱敏文本，并通过 MCP 工具跟踪新增或已修复问题。

entries.english: Check recruiters and job offers for scams: cross-checks company registration, domain age, look-alike domains, blocklists and crypto-scam databases.
entries.zh: 检查招聘者和工作机会是否存在诈骗：交叉核对公司注册、域名年龄、仿冒域名、阻止列表和加密货币诈骗数据库。

entries.english: Analyze AWS IAM policies and CloudFormation templates with Shieldly to flag privilege-escalation paths, wildcards and over-permissive access.
entries.zh: 使用 Shieldly 分析 AWS IAM 策略和 CloudFormation 模板，标记权限提升路径、通配符和过宽权限。

entries.english: Local-first domain security and privacy checker: live SPF, DMARC, DKIM, DNSSEC, TLS, CAA and security header checks, scored with remediation advice.
entries.zh: 本地优先的域名安全与隐私检查器：实时检查 SPF、DMARC、DKIM、DNSSEC、TLS、CAA 和安全标头，评分并提供修复建议。

entries.english: Find MCP servers by describing a task and get advisory trust screens before connecting, using the mcpindex directory.
entries.zh: 使用 mcpindex 目录，根据任务描述查找 MCP 服务器，并在连接前获取建议性的信任检查结果。

entries.english: Offline pre-flight security linter for MCP servers, agent tools and skills that returns SAFE, REVIEW, BLOCK or UNKNOWN verdicts without executing them.
entries.zh: 面向 MCP 服务器、代理工具和技能的离线执行前安全检查器，无需执行即可返回 SAFE、REVIEW、BLOCK 或 UNKNOWN 判定。

entries.english: U.S. exclusion, debarment and license screening (OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, state boards) with an Ed25519-signed receipt of the exact list snapshots checked.
entries.zh: 筛查美国排除、禁入和许可证名单（OIG LEIE、SAM.gov、州委员会），并为所检查的确切名单快照提供 Ed25519 签名凭据。

entries.english: Check the reputation of AI microservices and public APIs before calling them and submit ratings afterward, via an open trust registry.
entries.zh: 通过开放信任注册表在调用前检查 AI 微服务和公共 API 的信誉，并在调用后提交评价。

entries.english: Runtime security proxy for MCP that blocks prompt injection, SSRF, shell/SQL injection and credential exfiltration, plus trust scores for npm MCP packages.
entries.zh: MCP 运行时安全代理，阻止提示注入、SSRF、shell/SQL 注入和凭据外传，并为 npm MCP 包提供信任评分。

entries.english: Author, lint, validate and convert Sigma detection rules with RSigma, evaluate and explain detections against log events, and inspect correlation state.
entries.zh: 使用 RSigma 编写、检查、验证和转换 Sigma 检测规则，依据日志事件评估并解释检测结果，查看关联状态。

entries.english: Verifiable execution protocol for agent tool calls: signed policy decisions, causal evidence chains and offline verification from a SQLite ledger.
entries.zh: 面向代理工具调用的可验证执行协议：签名策略决策、因果证据链和基于 SQLite 账本的离线验证。

entries.english: Policy proxy that refuses forbidden tool calls, stopping prompt-injection exfiltration and forbidden data combinations across Slack, Drive, GitHub and more.
entries.zh: 策略代理拒绝被禁止的工具调用，阻止 Slack、Drive、GitHub 等服务间的提示注入数据外传和禁止的数据组合。

entries.english: Exactly-once payments for agents: prevents double settlement across processes and retries, confirms charges with the provider and reconciles out-of-band spend.
entries.zh: 面向代理的恰好一次支付：防止跨进程和重试重复结算，与支付提供商确认扣款，并核对带外支出。

entries.english: Screen x402 payment counterparties before paying: address sanity, payTo swap, transport safety and spend policy checks with an allow, review or block verdict.
entries.zh: 付款前筛查 x402 支付对手方：检查地址合理性、payTo 替换、传输安全和支出策略，给出允许、审查或阻止判定。

entries.english: Static scanner that checks Claude Code skills, plugins and MCP servers for exfiltration, install hooks and prompt injection before you install them.
entries.zh: 静态扫描器，在安装前检查 Claude Code 技能、插件和 MCP 服务器中的数据外传、安装钩子和提示注入。

entries.english: Execution safety for agent actions: a YAML-policy gateway that allows, holds or denies tool calls, plus an approval queue and hash-chained receipts.
entries.zh: 代理操作执行安全：基于 YAML 策略的网关允许、暂缓或拒绝工具调用，并提供审批队列及哈希链凭据。

entries.english: MAC address (OUI) vendor lookup with randomized-address detection, plus router default login IPs and admin credentials cited to manufacturer documentation.
entries.zh: 查询 MAC 地址（OUI）厂商并检测随机地址，同时提供路由器默认登录 IP 和管理员凭据，并引用制造商文档。

entries.english: Accountability layer for AI agents: per-version passports, per-job mandates with spending limits, a fail-closed action gate and a hash-chained journal.
entries.zh: AI 代理问责层：按版本签发护照、按任务设置带支出限制的授权委任、默认拒绝操作关卡和哈希链日志。

entries.english: APK reverse engineering workspace that orchestrates jadx, apktool, adb and Frida through a workflow engine, on Termux (Android) or PC.
entries.zh: APK 逆向工程工作区，通过工作流引擎编排 jadx、apktool、adb 和 Frida，可在 Termux（Android）或 PC 上运行。

entries.english: Query the Small Print record: versioned, diffed tool descriptions and schemas of MCP servers, skills and plugins, with graded changes and public advisories.
entries.zh: 查询 Small Print 记录：MCP 服务器、技能和插件的工具说明及模式版本与差异，附变更等级和公开公告。

entries.english: Offline safety gate for agent shell commands: rates each command as danger, caution or none and explains every flag, pipe, redirect and subshell.
entries.zh: 面向代理 shell 命令的离线安全关卡：将每条命令评为危险、警惕或无风险，并解释每个标志、管道、重定向和子 shell。

entries.english: Deterministic execution governance gateway and W3C DID security guardrail for AI agent MCP tool calls.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理 MCP 工具调用的确定性执行治理网关和 W3C DID 安全防护。

entries.english: Zero-trust security proxy, pre-execution blast radius simulation, DLP secret redaction, and cryptographic audit logging for MCP.
entries.zh: 面向 MCP 的零信任安全代理、执行前影响范围模拟、DLP 密钥脱敏及加密审计日志。

entries.english: Offline security helpers for AI-built (vibe-coded) apps: classify whether a key is safe to expose, generate Supabase RLS audit SQL and owner-only policy templates, and pre-launch checklists for Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit and v0. Ships with a Cursor rule and an Agent Skill.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 构建（vibe-coded）应用的离线安全助手：判断密钥是否适合公开，生成 Supabase RLS 审计 SQL 和仅所有者策略模板，并提供 Lovable、Bolt、Cursor、Replit 和 v0 上线前检查清单。附带 Cursor 规则和代理技能。

entries.english: Sits between an agent and its tools: every call passes a policy gate and leaves a signed decision record before it runs, a refusal is recorded like an approval, payments wait for an operator on the same machine, and the ledger stays there and verifies offline. Apache-2.0.
entries.zh: 位于代理及其工具之间：每次调用执行前都经过策略关卡并留下签名决策记录，拒绝与批准一样会被记录；支付等待同一机器上的操作员，账本保留在该机器并可离线验证。Apache-2.0。

entries.english: Deterministic prompt-injection detector, concealed Unicode scrubber, and honeypot wallet defense MCP server for AI agents.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的确定性提示注入检测器、隐藏 Unicode 清理器和蜜罐钱包防御 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Public Instagram data: profiles and post feeds by handle, with follower counts, captions, hashtags and mentions parsed as JSON.
entries.zh: 公开 Instagram 数据：按用户名获取个人资料及帖子流，将粉丝数、配文、话题标签和提及解析为 JSON。

entries.english: Public Facebook pages and profiles as JSON: likes, followers, talking-about counts, contact details and post feeds with reactions.
entries.zh: 公开 Facebook 页面及个人资料 JSON：点赞数、粉丝数、讨论人数、联系方式及带回应的帖子流。

entries.english: YouTube search, video and channel data and transcripts as JSON.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供 YouTube 搜索、视频和频道数据及文字稿。

entries.english: Public TikTok data as JSON: profile lookup, account videos, comments and reply threads, and keyword search over videos or creators.
entries.zh: 以 JSON 提供公开 TikTok 数据：查询个人资料、账户视频、评论及回复线程，并按关键词搜索视频或创作者。

entries.english: YouTube outlier research: rank a channel's uploads against its own baseline (Shorts and long-form separately), compare channels and find niche overperformers.
entries.zh: YouTube 异常表现研究：将频道上传内容与其自身基线比较排名（Shorts 与长视频分开），比较频道并发现细分领域表现突出的内容。

entries.english: Schedule and manage social media posts on Bluesky, Threads, Instagram, LinkedIn, Mastodon, YouTube, X, Discord and more, with a draft-first workflow.
entries.zh: 在 Bluesky、Threads、Instagram、LinkedIn、Mastodon、YouTube、X、Discord 等平台安排和管理社交媒体帖子，采用草稿优先工作流。

entries.english: Create, edit and delete LinkedIn posts (text, image, article), upload images, fetch profiles, look up company pages and check follower counts.
entries.zh: 创建、编辑和删除 LinkedIn 帖子（文本、图片、文章）、上传图片、获取个人资料、查询公司页面及查看粉丝数。

entries.english: Schedule and cross-post to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn and more, with per-platform captions, bulk scheduling, draft approval and media upload.
entries.zh: 安排并跨平台发布到 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X、LinkedIn 等，支持各平台配文、批量排程、草稿审批和媒体上传。

entries.english: Upload videos to YouTube directly from an AI assistant.
entries.zh: 从 AI 助手直接上传视频到 YouTube。

entries.english: Instagram analytics: account overviews, posts, followers and following lists, post insights, and search for users, hashtags or places.
entries.zh: Instagram 分析：账户概览、帖子、粉丝和关注列表、帖子洞察，以及搜索用户、话题标签或地点。

entries.english: Video-first publishing: schedule, publish, update, delete and retry video and image posts on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram.
entries.zh: 视频优先发布：在 YouTube、TikTok 和 Instagram 上排程、发布、更新、删除及重试视频和图片帖子。

entries.english: Schedule and publish posts across 15 social networks from one place. Hosted server at `mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp` with tools for posts, schedules, media uploads, labels, approvals and analytics.
entries.zh: 从一个位置向 15 个社交网络安排和发布帖子。托管服务器位于 `mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp`，提供帖子、排程、媒体上传、标签、审批和分析工具。

entries.english: Turn URLs into viral posts with a remake command.
entries.zh: 通过重制命令将 URL 转为热门帖子。

entries.english: Post tweets, search, read timelines, manage engagement and upload media on Twitter/X using browser cookies.
entries.zh: 使用浏览器 Cookie 在 Twitter/X 上发布推文、搜索、阅读时间线、管理互动和上传媒体。

entries.english: Check posts against real character limits before publishing on X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Threads, Mastodon and Discord, including URL and emoji weighting.
entries.zh: 在 X、Bluesky、LinkedIn、Threads、Mastodon 和 Discord 发布前，按照实际字符限制检查帖子，包括 URL 和 emoji 的计权。

entries.english: Read Substack posts, manage drafts, publish Notes, get comments and upload images; it cannot publish or delete posts.
entries.zh: 阅读 Substack 文章、管理草稿、发布 Notes、获取评论和上传图片；不能发布或删除文章。

entries.english: Local-first TikTok Content Posting API server and CLI with OAuth readiness checks, dry-run publishing and live uploads only when explicitly enabled.
entries.zh: 本地优先的 TikTok 内容发布 API 服务器和 CLI，提供 OAuth 就绪检查、试运行发布，只有明确启用时才实际上传。

entries.english: LinkedIn via an authenticated browser session: profiles, people/job/company search, feed, messaging and gated writes (connect, post, react, comment).
entries.zh: 通过已认证浏览器会话访问 LinkedIn：个人资料、人物/职位/公司搜索、信息流和消息，以及受控制的写操作（建立联系、发帖、回应、评论）。

entries.english: Search and read public YouTube, and manage your own channels: analytics, uploads, metadata, playlists and comment moderation, with two-step deletes. Also a CLI (`ytk`).

entries.zh: 本地优先访问 WHOOP 恢复、HRV、睡眠、负荷和表现数据，令牌存储在本地。

entries.english: Personalized Fantasy Premier League insights: captain picks, transfer suggestions, differentials, fixture outlook, price predictions and live points.
entries.zh: 个性化 Fantasy Premier League 洞察：队长人选、转会建议、差异化球员、赛程前景、价格预测和实时积分。

entries.english: Exercise-to-muscle mapping: look up muscles worked by exercises, analyze workouts for gaps and find alternative exercises ranked by muscle overlap.
entries.zh: 动作与肌肉映射：查询训练动作锻炼的肌肉、分析训练中的缺口，并按肌肉重合度排序替代动作。

entries.english: NFL fantasy football: head-to-head player comparisons, PPR, half-PPR and standard rankings, positional scarcity and bye-week conflicts, with cited sources.
entries.zh: NFL 梦幻橄榄球：球员一对一比较、PPR、半 PPR 和标准排名、位置稀缺性及轮空周冲突，并附来源。

entries.english: Suunto watch data via the Suunto API: workouts, time-series samples, FIT decoding, GPX export, 24/7 activity, sleep and recovery/HRV.
entries.zh: 通过 Suunto API 获取手表数据：训练、时间序列样本、FIT 解码、GPX 导出、全天候活动（24/7）、睡眠和恢复/HRV。

entries.english: Proxy to the public MLB API for player info, stats and game information.
entries.zh: 公开 MLB API 的代理，用于获取球员信息、统计和比赛信息。

entries.english: Read and write Garmin Connect: activities with per-set strength detail, laps, health data and two-year trends; strength, run, ride and swim workouts pushed to a watch; completed strength sessions logged as activities; and weigh-ins with full body composition.
entries.zh: 读写 Garmin Connect：含逐组力量训练详情的活动、圈数、健康数据和两年趋势；将力量、跑步、骑行及游泳训练推送到手表；将完成的力量训练记录为活动；以及记录包含完整身体成分的称重数据。

entries.english: Live sports betting player props for NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, NCAA and soccer, unified from sportsbooks with American odds, pre-game and live.
entries.zh: 来自各投注平台的 NBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、NCAA 和足球实时球员特殊投注数据，统一提供美式赔率，覆盖赛前和实时。

entries.english: Query TrainingPeaks workouts, analyze CTL/ATL/TSB fitness metrics and compare power and pace PRs.
entries.zh: 查询 TrainingPeaks 训练、分析 CTL/ATL/TSB 体能指标，并比较功率和配速个人纪录。

entries.english: FIFA World Cup 2026 data: matches, teams, venues, city guides, fan zones, visa requirements, injuries, odds and standings.
entries.zh: 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯数据：比赛、球队、场馆、城市指南、球迷区、签证要求、伤情、赔率和积分榜。

entries.english: Arvo AI workout coach: access training data, workout history, personal records and body progress.
entries.zh: Arvo AI 训练教练：访问训练数据、训练历史、个人纪录和身体进展。

entries.english: ESPN fantasy football tools: draft simulations, lineup recommendations and browser actions within configurable user limits.
entries.zh: ESPN 梦幻橄榄球工具：选秀模拟、阵容建议及在可配置用户限制内的浏览器操作。

entries.english: Live and historical NBA statistics: player stats, game scores, team data and advanced analytics.
entries.zh: 实时和历史 NBA 统计：球员数据、比赛比分、球队数据和高级分析。

entries.english: Aggregated sports data: live scores, standings, player stats and betting odds for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, tennis, cricket, golf, MMA, F1 and esports.
entries.zh: 聚合体育数据：NFL、NBA、MLB、NHL、足球、网球、板球、高尔夫、MMA、F1 和电竞的实时比分、积分榜、球员统计及投注赔率。

entries.english: Real-time ATP, WTA, Challenger and ITF tennis data: live scores, players, fixtures, model win probability and match-winner market prices.
entries.zh: 实时 ATP、WTA、Challenger 和 ITF 网球数据：比分、球员、赛程、模型胜率和比赛胜者市场价格。

entries.english: Sports intelligence: schedules, live scores, odds, betting splits and explainable bet confidence.
entries.zh: 体育情报：赛程、实时比分、赔率、投注分布和可解释的投注置信度。

entries.english: Generates mountain bike and road cycling routes on real OpenStreetMap data with BRouter (automatic loops to a target distance, point-to-point and via points) and saves them as GPX with elevation, plus warnings for traffic, steep grades, protected areas and ways where bikes are not allowed.
entries.zh: 使用 BRouter 基于真实 OpenStreetMap 数据生成山地车和公路骑行路线（按目标距离自动生成环线、点到点和途经点），保存为带海拔的 GPX，并提示交通、陡坡、保护区及禁止骑行的道路。

entries.english: Player, team and game information for the NBA, NFL and MLB via the balldontlie API.
entries.zh: 通过 balldontlie API 获取 NBA、NFL 和 MLB 的球员、球队及比赛信息。

entries.english: XERT cycling analytics: fitness signature (FTP, HIE, PP), training status, workouts, activities with XSS metrics and MPA analysis.
entries.zh: XERT 骑行分析：体能特征（FTP、HIE、PP）、训练状态、训练、带 XSS 指标的活动及 MPA 分析。

entries.english: Combines MacroFactor nutrition data with Garmin training data for recovery checks, daily briefings, weekly reports and nutrition-performance correlations.
entries.zh: 结合 MacroFactor 营养数据和 Garmin 训练数据，进行恢复检查、每日简报、每周报告及营养与表现相关性分析。

entries.english: Official [Odds-API.io](https://odds-api.io) server: real-time and historical sports betting odds from 365+ bookmakers across 34 sports, with events, value bets, arbitrage and dropping odds.
entries.zh: 官方 [Odds-API.io](https://odds-api.io) 服务器：来自 365 家以上博彩公司、覆盖 34 项运动的实时和历史体育投注赔率，提供赛事、价值投注、套利和下降赔率。

entries.english: Official OddsRelay server: UK and Irish bookmaker and exchange odds, matched boards, one event's prices, and the sport, bookmaker and coverage lists. Read-only; every call that spends tokens is priced first and capped.
entries.zh: 官方 OddsRelay 服务器：英国和爱尔兰博彩公司及交易所赔率、匹配盘口、单场赛事价格，以及运动、博彩公司和覆盖范围列表。只读；每次消耗令牌的调用都会先报价并设定上限。

entries.english: Read-only Bosch eBike Flow (Smart System) data: battery health and charge cycles, components and firmware, live charge level and per-ride activity.
entries.zh: 只读 Bosch eBike Flow（Smart System）数据：电池健康与充电周期、组件和固件、实时电量及每次骑行活动。

entries.english: Fitbit Web API access with a local SQLite cache and trend analysis for heart rate, activity, exercises, sleep, weight, SpO2 and HRV.
entries.zh: 访问 Fitbit Web API，提供本地 SQLite 缓存和心率、活动、运动、睡眠、体重、血氧及 HRV 趋势分析。

entries.english: Google Health API with a local SQLite cache, offline mode and trend analysis for heart rate, activity, sleep, weight, SpO2, HRV, ECG and irregular rhythms.
entries.zh: Google Health API，提供本地 SQLite 缓存、离线模式及心率、活动、睡眠、体重、血氧、HRV、心电图和心律不齐趋势分析。

entries.english: Withings Health API with a local SQLite cache and trend analysis for body composition, sleep, activity, workouts and ECG.
entries.zh: Withings Health API，提供本地 SQLite 缓存以及身体成分、睡眠、活动、训练和心电图趋势分析。

entries.english: Live Australian racing and sports odds from 14 AU bookmakers for AI assistants: next races with every bookmaker's price per runner, best price, settled results and market movers, each price stamped with its age.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 助手的澳大利亚赛马与体育实时赔率，来自 14 家澳大利亚博彩公司：即将开始的比赛、每名参赛者在各公司的价格、最佳价格、已结算结果和市场变动，每个价格均标注距更新时间。

entries.english: Live sports betting odds, cross-book +EV and graded prop resolution against box scores for MLB, NBA, NHL, NFL, soccer and UFC.
entries.zh: MLB、NBA、NHL、NFL、足球和 UFC 的实时体育投注赔率、跨平台正期望值（+EV）及根据技术统计核定的特殊投注结果。

entries.english: Access Strava data via the Strava API.
entries.zh: 通过 Strava API 访问 Strava 数据。

entries.english: Local-first health context from WHOOP and Apple Health: sleep, recovery, workouts and personal baselines in a local SQLite store.
entries.zh: 来自 WHOOP 和 Apple Health 的本地优先健康上下文：睡眠、恢复、训练和个人基线存储在本地 SQLite 中。

entries.english: WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain and workouts with trend analysis, lag-aware correlations, training load and full-history export, plus a demo mode.
entries.zh: WHOOP 恢复、睡眠、负荷和训练数据，提供趋势分析、考虑滞后的相关性、训练负荷和完整历史导出，并提供演示模式。

entries.english: Control MultiViewer, an app for watching motorsports like Formula 1, World Endurance Championship and IndyCar.
entries.zh: 控制 MultiViewer，这是一款观看 Formula 1、世界耐力锦标赛和 IndyCar 等赛车运动的应用。

entries.english: Unofficial Mi Fitness connector: local SQLite storage and JSON/CSV exports of sleep, activity, workouts and other records.
entries.zh: 非官方 Mi Fitness 连接器：将睡眠、活动、训练和其他记录存储到本地 SQLite，并导出 JSON/CSV。

entries.english: Create structured Garmin Connect workouts from natural language: pace, HR, power and cadence targets, repeat blocks, swim strokes and pool lengths.
entries.zh: 根据自然语言创建结构化 Garmin Connect 训练：配速、心率、功率和踏频目标，重复组、泳姿和泳池长度。

entries.english: Read-only TheRundown data for sports, markets, affiliates, events, futures and open main-line odds.
entries.zh: 只读 TheRundown 数据，涵盖体育项目、市场、关联方、赛事、期货和未关闭的主线赔率。

entries.english: Trainzilla for personal trainers: manage clients, workout and diet plans, check-ins, habits, sessions and billing (hosted OAuth endpoint or local).
entries.zh: 面向私人教练的 Trainzilla：管理客户、训练和饮食计划、签到、习惯、课程和计费（托管 OAuth 端点或本地）。

entries.english: Running calculators: pace, time and distance, race time predictions (Riegel formula), heart rate training zones (Karvonen method) and marathon event data.
entries.zh: 跑步计算器：配速、时间和距离，比赛时间预测（Riegel 公式）、心率训练区间（Karvonen 方法）及马拉松赛事数据。

entries.english: Sports betting picks, odds, injuries and line movement for NBA, NHL, NCAAB and MLB, with visual bet slip cards showing edges.
entries.zh: NBA、NHL、NCAAB 和 MLB 的体育投注推荐、赔率、伤情及盘口变化，并提供展示优势的可视化投注单卡片。

entries.english: Read workouts, sleep, nutrition and recovery data from Apple Health, Fitbit, Oura and Google Health Connect, with inline chart widgets.
entries.zh: 从 Apple Health、Fitbit、Oura 和 Google Health Connect 读取训练、睡眠、营养及恢复数据，提供内嵌图表小组件。

entries.english: Unofficial, read-only access to your Kilter Board climbing logbook: sessions, sends, projects, grade pyramid, progression and wall-angle comparison.
entries.zh: 非官方、只读访问你的 Kilter Board 攀岩日志：训练、完攀、项目、难度金字塔、进展和墙面角度比较。

entries.english: Local analysis of Garmin Connect activities, sleep, recovery, body composition, stress and VO2 max against 28-day baselines, with memory for goals and races.
entries.zh: 以 28 天基线为参照，本地分析 Garmin Connect 活动、睡眠、恢复、身体成分、压力和最大摄氧量，并记忆目标及赛事。

entries.english: Support desk for AI agents: run tickets with per-action x402 USDC payments, or create and run a bounty board owned by the paying wallet.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的支持服务台：按操作以 x402 USDC 付费处理工单，或创建和运营由付款钱包拥有的赏金看板。

entries.english: Search and retrieve Yandex Tracker issues, queues and users.
entries.zh: 搜索和获取 Yandex Tracker 议题、队列和用户。

entries.english: Manage your website's Asyntai AI support agent: knowledge base, agent instructions, conversations and leads, live visitor replies and plan usage.
entries.zh: 管理网站的 Asyntai AI 支持代理：知识库、代理指令、对话和潜在线索、实时回复访客及套餐用量。

entries.english: BugHerd bug tracking: list projects, filter tasks by status, priority or tag, get task details and read comments.
entries.zh: BugHerd 缺陷跟踪：列出项目，按状态、优先级或标签筛选任务，获取任务详情并阅读评论。

entries.english: Field-service dispatch and technician scheduling: book jobs against live availability, quote and confirm, and reschedule around emergencies.
entries.zh: 现场服务派遣与技术人员排班：根据实时空闲情况预约工作、报价和确认，并因应紧急情况重新排程。

entries.english: Self-hosted Freshdesk server: ticket search, conversations, attachment text extraction, image OCR and status, group and company enrichment.
entries.zh: 自托管 Freshdesk 服务器：工单搜索、对话、附件文本提取、图片 OCR，并补充状态、群组和公司信息。

entries.english: Expose your Quickchat AI agent as an MCP server, giving AI apps real-time access to its knowledge base and conversational capabilities.
entries.zh: 将 Quickchat AI 代理公开为 MCP 服务器，让 AI 应用实时访问其知识库和对话能力。

entries.english: Read and write Zendesk tickets, comments, views, macros, users, groups, organizations and time tracking, with optional Help Center and GitLab integration.
entries.zh: 读写 Zendesk 工单、评论、视图、宏、用户、群组、组织和时间跟踪，可选集成帮助中心与 GitLab。

entries.english: Small-business customer service via CallChatSyn: answer customer questions from the business's own FAQs (English/Chinese), list open appointment times in its time zone, and book appointments.
entries.zh: 通过 CallChatSyn 提供小企业客服：根据企业自己的常见问题（英文/中文）回答客户问题，以其时区列出可预约时段并预约。

entries.english: Jira and Confluence: issue CRUD, sprint lifecycle, comments, transitions, user management and wiki pages.
entries.zh: Jira 和 Confluence：议题增删改查、冲刺生命周期、评论、状态转换、用户管理和 Wiki 页面。

entries.english: IT Glue, the MSP documentation platform: semantic search over documentation, document and flexible-asset read/write, and role-based access control.
entries.zh: 面向 MSP 的文档平台 IT Glue：对文档进行语义搜索，读写文档和灵活资产，并提供基于角色的访问控制。

entries.english: InvGate Service Desk: incidents, users, knowledge base, assets, custom fields, workflows and time tracking, read-only by default with opt-in writes.
entries.zh: InvGate Service Desk：事件、用户、知识库、资产、自定义字段、工作流和时间跟踪，默认只读，可选择启用写入。

entries.english: Spanish dialect localization: translate and QA-check text across 25 regional variants with register control, structure preservation and quality gates.
entries.zh: 西班牙语方言本地化：在 25 种地区变体之间翻译和质量检查文本，支持语体控制、结构保留和质量关卡。

entries.english: Weblate translation management: translation tasks, project management and content discovery with format transformations.
entries.zh: Weblate 翻译管理：翻译任务、项目管理和内容发现，支持格式转换。

entries.english: Translate app string files (JSON, .arb, .po, .strings, Android XML) into 46 languages with placeholder-safe, reproducible output.
entries.zh: 将应用字符串文件（JSON、.arb、.po、.strings、Android XML）翻译为 46 种语言，输出可复现且保证占位符安全。

entries.english: Translation quality evaluation with xCOMET models: quality scoring, error detection with severity levels and batch processing.
entries.zh: 使用 xCOMET 模型评估翻译质量：质量评分、按严重程度检测错误及批量处理。

entries.english: Manage app strings, locales and A/B string variants, then publish Ed25519-signed string bundles for over-the-air text updates in iOS, Android, web and React Native apps.
entries.zh: 管理应用字符串、语言区域和 A/B 字符串变体，然后发布 Ed25519 签名的字符串包，为 iOS、Android、网页和 React Native 应用提供空中文本更新。

entries.english: Real-time English-Mandarin speech translation: local Whisper transcription, translation via the Claude API and local speech synthesis with Piper TTS.
entries.zh: 实时英语与普通话语音翻译：本地 Whisper 转写、通过 Claude API 翻译，并使用 Piper TTS 在本地合成语音。

entries.english: Local audio and video transcription on Windows using whisper.cpp with Vulkan GPU acceleration: batch processing, multilingual support and background jobs.
entries.zh: 在 Windows 上使用 whisper.cpp 和 Vulkan GPU 加速进行本地音视频转写，支持批量处理、多语言和后台任务。

entries.english: Transcribe audio, video, YouTube links and podcast feeds via Pepys, with speaker diarization, SRT/VTT export and transcript search.
entries.zh: 通过 Pepys 转写音频、视频、YouTube 链接和播客订阅源，支持说话人区分、SRT/VTT 导出和文字稿搜索。

entries.english: Local speech-to-text and SRT/VTT subtitles for audio and video in 99 languages on your own AMD, NVIDIA, Intel or Apple GPU (whisper.cpp via Vulkan/CUDA/Metal), with an accurate mode using Thai and Hindi fine-tunes.
entries.zh: 在自己的 AMD、NVIDIA、Intel 或 Apple GPU 上为 99 种语言的音视频提供本地语音转文字和 SRT/VTT 字幕（通过 Vulkan/CUDA/Metal 使用 whisper.cpp），另有使用泰语和印地语微调的高精度模式。

entries.english: Search podcast episodes and fetch published transcripts as Markdown with real speaker names via the Spoken API.
entries.zh: 通过 Spoken API 搜索播客节目，并以带真实说话人姓名的 Markdown 获取已发布文字稿。

entries.english: Generate text-to-speech and text-to-voice audio with the DAISYS platform, and play and store the generated audio.
entries.zh: 使用 DAISYS 平台生成文本转语音和文本转声音音频，并播放及保存生成的音频。

entries.english: Speech tools: pronunciation assessment with phoneme-level feedback, speech-to-text with language detection and text-to-speech with multiple voices.
entries.zh: 语音工具：提供音素级反馈的发音评估、带语言检测的语音转文字和多种声音的文字转语音。

entries.english: Pay-per-call x402 speech generation on Base: multiple voices, personas and languages, speed and quality controls, OpenAI-style requests and batch audio.
entries.zh: 在 Base 上通过 x402 按次付费生成语音：多种声音、角色和语言，速度与质量控制、OpenAI 风格请求和批量音频。

entries.english: Local text-to-speech from an on-device model with multiple voices and languages, cloned voice profiles and WAV, FLAC, MP3 or Opus output.
entries.zh: 使用设备端模型进行本地文字转语音，支持多种声音和语言、克隆声音配置，以及 WAV、FLAC、MP3 或 Opus 输出。

entries.english: Voice interaction: speech-to-text, text-to-speech and real-time voice conversations via local microphone, OpenAI-compatible APIs and LiveKit.
entries.zh: 语音交互：通过本地麦克风、兼容 OpenAI 的 API 和 LiveKit 进行语音转文字、文字转语音和实时语音对话。

entries.english: Text-to-speech with the open-weight Kokoro TTS models, saving MP3s locally or uploading them to an S3 bucket.
entries.zh: 使用开放权重的 Kokoro TTS 模型进行文字转语音，将 MP3 保存到本地或上传到 S3 存储桶。

entries.english: Transcribe audio and video files and voice memos and work with their text content.
entries.zh: 转写音频和视频文件及语音备忘录，并处理其文本内容。

entries.english: Text-to-speech for Claude Code using OpenAI's TTS API, with multiple voices and cross-platform playback.
entries.zh: 使用 OpenAI TTS API 为 Claude Code 提供文字转语音，支持多种声音和跨平台播放。

entries.english: Find, book, and pay for local offline social activities (board games, badminton, hiking, frisbee and 100+ hobby categories) across cities in China via natural language. Hosted MCP gateway (agent.cuqu.net) with per-user API keys; also supports organizer-side event creation and venue search.
entries.zh: 通过自然语言查找、预订并支付中国各城市的本地线下社交活动（桌游、羽毛球、徒步、飞盘及 100 多种爱好类别）。托管 MCP 网关（agent.cuqu.net）使用按用户分配的 API 密钥；也支持组织者创建活动和搜索场地。

entries.english: Search Airbnb stays by location, dates and guests, and read full listing details (price, amenities, host, reviews) as JSON.
entries.zh: 按地点、日期和人数搜索 Airbnb 住宿，并以 JSON 阅读完整房源详情（价格、设施、房东、评价）。

entries.english: Remote MCP server for Google Flights: one-way, round-trip and multi-city itineraries with fares, legs, layovers, carbon emissions and price history, as JSON.
entries.zh: Google Flights 远程 MCP 服务器：以 JSON 提供单程、往返和多城市行程，包括票价、航段、中转、碳排放和价格历史。

entries.english: Remote MCP server for Google Hotels: search hotels and vacation rentals for a stay with rates, ratings and amenities, then open one property with the rate at every booking site Google compares, as JSON.
entries.zh: Google Hotels 远程 MCP 服务器：搜索指定住宿日期的酒店和度假房源，获取价格、评分及设施，然后打开单个房源并查看 Google 比较的各预订网站价格，结果为 JSON。

entries.english: Search Booking.com stays by destination and dates, and read full property details (rooms, rates, facilities, review scores) as JSON.
entries.zh: 按目的地和日期搜索 Booking.com 住宿，并以 JSON 阅读完整房源详情（房间、价格、设施、评价分数）。

entries.english: Turn a plain-language trip description into dated flight deals from one origin, with the typical price beside each fare, airlines, stops and booking links, as JSON.
entries.zh: 将通俗语言的旅行描述转为从一个出发地出发、带日期的航班优惠，以 JSON 提供每个票价旁的典型价格、航空公司、中转和预订链接。

entries.english: Scuba dive planning: ranked dive-forecast windows, month-by-month climatology, marine-life seasonality from GBIF sightings and dive site facts.
entries.zh: 水肺潜水规划：排序后的潜水预测窗口、逐月气候、来自 GBIF 目击记录的海洋生物季节性及潜点信息。

entries.english: Multi-city flight routing: plan round-the-world trips, validate Star Alliance and oneworld routings, and get per-segment carrier recommendations.
entries.zh: 多城市航班路线规划：规划环球旅行、验证星空联盟和寰宇一家的路线，并获取各航段承运商建议。

entries.english: Tokyo nightlife: event discovery, venue search, performer info, recommendations and VIP table booking.
entries.zh: 东京夜生活：活动发现、场所搜索、表演者信息、推荐和 VIP 桌位预订。

entries.english: Luxembourg public data: laws, statistics, live parking and traffic, weather alerts, environment, parliament, geodata, GTFS stops and the open-data catalogue.
entries.zh: 卢森堡公开数据：法律、统计、实时停车与交通、天气警报、环境、议会、地理数据、GTFS 站点和开放数据目录。

entries.english: Unofficial Samsara fleet management: vehicles and live locations, route creation and optimization, driver records, Hours-of-Service compliance and webhooks.
entries.zh: 非官方 Samsara 车队管理：车辆及实时位置、路线创建和优化、驾驶员记录、服务时长合规和 Webhook。

entries.english: Travel agent: search live flights, hotels, activities and events worldwide and complete bookings on Autonomad.
entries.zh: 旅行代理：搜索全球实时航班、酒店、活动和赛事，并在 Autonomad 完成预订。

entries.english: Search campgrounds worldwide on Campertunity, check availability and get booking links.
entries.zh: 在 Campertunity 搜索全球露营地、检查可用性并获取预订链接。

entries.english: Query Tesla vehicle data and analytics from your TeslaMate database.
entries.zh: 从 TeslaMate 数据库查询特斯拉车辆数据和分析结果。

entries.english: Travel compliance and booking for digital nomads in Europe: visa requirements, tax residency, Schengen 90/180-day tracking, accommodation and transport.
entries.zh: 面向欧洲数字游民的旅行合规与预订：签证要求、税务居民身份、申根 90/180 天跟踪、住宿和交通。

entries.english: Flight Master DAST aviation data: flight status, route search, onboard comfort, delay and cancellation risk, airport weather and flight trajectories.
entries.zh: Flight Master DAST 航空数据：航班状态、路线搜索、机上舒适度、延误与取消风险、机场天气和飞行轨迹。

entries.english: Monthly sunshine scores, temperatures, rainfall and sea temperatures for destinations: sunny-month rankings, when-to-visit lookups and comparisons.
entries.zh: 目的地逐月日照评分、气温、降雨量和海水温度：晴朗月份排名、适合旅行时间查询和比较。

entries.english: World train-route atlas: search notable high-speed, scenic and night train routes and get facts and geometry for each.
entries.zh: 全球铁路路线图集：搜索著名高铁、风景线和夜间列车路线，获取每条路线的信息和几何数据。

entries.english: Travel utilities and x402 pay-per-call travel intelligence: disruption checks, day trips, weekend getaways, weather-aware planning and currency conversion.
entries.zh: 旅行实用工具和通过 x402 按次付费的旅行情报：出行中断检查、一日游、周末短途游、考虑天气的规划及货币转换。

entries.english: Travel search workflow: airport lookup, route comparison, timing guidance and external booking links via generic travel search providers.
entries.zh: 旅行搜索工作流：通过通用旅行搜索提供商查询机场、比较路线、提供时间建议和外部预订链接。

entries.english: Cash and award (points) rates side by side for hotels, flights and rental cars, with cents-per-point valuations, loyalty balances, rate alerts and booking.
entries.zh: 并排比较酒店、航班和租车的现金及奖励积分价格，提供每积分价值估算、忠诚计划余额、价格警报和预订。

entries.english: Fuel prices at gas stations in Spain from the Spanish government's open data API, sorted by price per municipality.
entries.zh: 通过西班牙政府开放数据 API 获取西班牙加油站燃油价格，按市镇价格排序。

entries.english: Kid-friendly hotels in Japan: search by verified conditions such as baby beds, diaper-friendly baths and kids' meals, with sources and verification dates.
entries.zh: 适合儿童的日本酒店：按经验证条件搜索，如婴儿床、适合换尿布的浴室和儿童餐，并提供来源及验证日期。

entries.english: Direct booking for vacation rentals: discover a host's domain, verify signed stay offers, check live availability and prices, and book with the host.
entries.zh: 度假房源直接预订：发现房东域名、验证签名住宿报价、检查实时可用性及价格，并向房东预订。

entries.english: Japan seasonal travel: cherry blossom forecasts, autumn leaves, flower spots, fruit picking and festivals, using Japan Meteorological Corporation data.
entries.zh: 日本季节旅行：使用日本气象株式会社数据提供樱花预测、红叶、赏花地点、采果和节庆信息。

entries.english: TeslaMate analytics and Tesla Fleet API commands: telemetry, driving history, energy analytics and remote control of climate, charging, locks and sentry.
entries.zh: TeslaMate 分析和 Tesla Fleet API 命令：遥测、驾驶历史、能源分析，以及远程控制空调、充电、车锁和哨兵模式。

entries.english: Plan and manage Triplyfy itineraries with interactive maps, places and notes, and search and save flights.
entries.zh: 使用交互地图、地点和备注规划与管理 Triplyfy 行程，并搜索和保存航班。

entries.english: Buy travel eSIMs via Stripe or Bitcoin checkout and receive the QR code by email.
entries.zh: 通过 Stripe 或比特币结账购买旅行 eSIM，并通过邮件接收二维码。

entries.english: Read-only access to VeryChic flash-sale hotel deals: search and filter offers and check availability and prices by date.
entries.zh: 只读访问 VeryChic 酒店限时优惠：搜索和筛选报价，按日期查看可用性和价格。

entries.english: Travel planning via Plantrip: day-by-day itineraries, packing lists, weather insights and trip cost estimates, each as a shareable page.
entries.zh: 通过 Plantrip 规划旅行：每日行程、行李清单、天气洞察和旅行费用估算，每项均为可分享页面。

entries.english: Search and book flights from hundreds of airlines, plus hotels; nothing is booked until you approve by email. Checks every nearby airport, bag prices and each flight's on-time record.
entries.zh: 搜索和预订数百家航空公司的航班及酒店；收到你的邮件批准前不会预订。检查附近所有机场、行李价格和各航班准点记录。

entries.english: UK National Rail train schedules and live travel information via the Realtime Trains API.
entries.zh: 通过 Realtime Trains API 获取英国国家铁路列车时刻和实时出行信息。

entries.english: Search CuddlyNest hotels by destination and read live room options, prices, availability and cancellation policies from public listing pages.
entries.zh: 按目的地搜索 CuddlyNest 酒店，并从公开房源页面读取实时房型、价格、可用性和取消政策。

entries.english: Compare real-time Uber and Lyft fare estimates for a route, including surge, and find the cheapest option.
entries.zh: 比较指定路线的 Uber 和 Lyft 实时估价，包括动态加价，并找出最便宜的选项。

entries.english: Visa requirements for passport-destination pairs in 15 languages: visa types, required documents and travel tips.
entries.zh: 提供 15 种语言的护照与目的地组合签证要求：签证类型、所需文件和旅行提示。

entries.english: Germany's open mobility data: live Autobahn traffic and closures, DB train departures, local transit, fuel prices, EV charging, parking, bike sharing and DWD weather warnings, each answer with its source and licence. Free, no key.
entries.zh: 德国开放出行数据：实时高速公路交通与封闭、DB 列车发车、本地公交、燃油价格、电动车充电、停车、共享单车和 DWD 天气警报，每条回答附来源和许可证。免费，无需密钥。

entries.english: MAQAMI hotel and flight search with live rates and hotel details, then a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co.
entries.zh: MAQAMI 酒店和航班搜索，提供实时价格与酒店详情，然后给出 book.maqami.co 的安全结账链接。

entries.english: Bike, e-bike, kick scooter, motorcycle, wheelchair and walking routes across Europe from the On va où ? Routing API, with safe, balanced and fast variants.
entries.zh: 通过 On va où ? Routing API 获取覆盖欧洲的自行车、电动自行车、滑板车、摩托车、轮椅和步行路线，提供安全、平衡和快速方案。

entries.english: Free vanlife/RV road-trip data for AI agents: fuel prices (160+ countries), toll roads, visa and vehicle-import rules, holidays and peak traffic days, travel hazards and wildfires, customs, power plugs, weather suitability, currency, events. 25 read-only tools, no auth. Hosted `https://mcp.openvan.camp/mcp` or `npx -y @openvancamp/mcp-server`
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的免费房车旅行数据：燃油价格（160 多个国家）、收费公路、签证和车辆进口规则、假日及交通高峰日、旅行危险与山火、海关、电源插头、天气适宜性、货币和活动。25 个只读工具，无需认证。托管 `https://mcp.openvan.camp/mcp` 或 `npx -y @openvancamp/mcp-server`

entries.english: Rental car search with real-time prices from multiple providers worldwide.
entries.zh: 租车搜索，提供全球多家供应商的实时价格。

entries.english: Real-time bus and metro data in China via Chelaile: arrival times, vehicle positions, timetables, nearby stops and transit routing.
entries.zh: 通过车来了获取中国实时公交和地铁数据：到站时间、车辆位置、时刻表、附近站点及公交路线规划。

entries.english: Aviation data: decoded METAR weather by ICAO code, airport and aircraft specs, an aviation glossary and FAA-style practice questions.
entries.zh: 航空数据：按 ICAO 代码解码 METAR 天气、机场和飞机规格、航空术语表和 FAA 风格练习题。

entries.english: Events, reviewed places and ticket checkout in the Caribbean and Latin America: search festivals and venues, read reviews and create Stripe checkout links.
entries.zh: 加勒比地区和拉丁美洲的活动、带评价地点和票务结账：搜索节庆及场所、阅读评价并创建 Stripe 结账链接。

entries.english: Real-time flight data from the AviationStack API: airline flights, airport schedules, future flights and aircraft types.
entries.zh: 来自 AviationStack API 的实时航班数据：航空公司航班、机场时刻、未来航班和飞机类型。

entries.english: Read-only access to Hostaway vacation rental management: listings, reservations, calendar availability, guest conversations and owner financials.
entries.zh: 只读访问 Hostaway 度假房源管理：房源、预订、日历可用性、客人对话和房东财务。

entries.english: Buy and manage a global eSIM, paying per MB in USDT or USDC on chains such as TRON, Solana, Polygon and TON.
entries.zh: 购买和管理全球 eSIM，在 TRON、Solana、Polygon 和 TON 等链上以 USDT 或 USDC 按 MB 支付。

entries.english: Madurai CityBus transit: direct and one-transfer route planning, TNSTC stage fare breakdowns, platform bay departures and bilingual stop search.
entries.zh: Madurai CityBus 公交：直达及一次换乘路线规划、TNSTC 分段票价明细、站台发车和双语站点搜索。

entries.english: Multi-modal trip planning, transport locations and real-time public transport departures via the TripGo API.
entries.zh: 通过 TripGo API 进行多模式行程规划，查询交通地点和实时公共交通发车信息。

entries.english: Visa eligibility matching across immigration pathways in 15 countries: score a profile against government criteria and compare ranked pathways.
entries.zh: 在 15 个国家的移民途径中匹配签证资格：对照政府标准为个人资料评分，并比较排序后的途径。

entries.english: Freight tools: ADR dangerous goods, HS codes, LDM, CBM and chargeable weight calculators, duty estimation, airline codes and UN/LOCODE.
entries.zh: 货运工具：ADR 危险品、HS 编码、LDM、CBM 和计费重量计算器、关税估算、航空公司代码和 UN/LOCODE。

entries.english: Search AllTrails hiking trails and get detailed trail information.
entries.zh: 搜索 AllTrails 徒步路线并获取详细路线信息。

entries.english: German public infrastructure open data: weather, air quality, traffic, transit, parking and roadworks from DWD, Umweltbundesamt, Mobilithek and GovData.
entries.zh: 德国公共基础设施开放数据：来自 DWD、Umweltbundesamt、Mobilithek 和 GovData 的天气、空气质量、交通、公交、停车及道路施工信息。

entries.english: Discover and book theatre, shows, events, tours and experiences worldwide via tickadoo, with real-time prices, availability and booking links.
entries.zh: 通过 tickadoo 发现和预订全球戏剧、演出、活动、旅行团及体验，提供实时价格、可用性和预订链接。

entries.english: Compare real-time train, bus, ferry and private transfer prices between Italian cities.
entries.zh: 比较意大利城市之间火车、巴士、渡轮和私人接送的实时价格。

entries.english: Read and edit Wanderlog trip itineraries: trips, places, notes, hotels, checklists and dates.
entries.zh: 阅读和编辑 Wanderlog 旅行行程：旅行、地点、备注、酒店、清单和日期。

entries.english: Real-time Lviv (Ukraine) public transport: stop arrivals, live vehicle positions, route geometry and nearby stop discovery.
entries.zh: 乌克兰利沃夫实时公共交通：站点到达时间、实时车辆位置、路线几何数据和附近站点发现。

entries.english: Maritime vessel tracking via VesselAPI: search vessels and get real-time positions, ETAs, port events, emissions, inspections and NAVTEX safety messages.
entries.zh: 通过 VesselAPI 跟踪海上船舶：搜索船舶并获取实时位置、预计到达时间、港口事件、排放、检查和 NAVTEX 安全消息。

entries.english: Unofficial Ryanair flight search: find one-way fares, explore destinations by country or region and find the cheapest day to fly between two airports.
entries.zh: 非官方 Ryanair 航班搜索：查找单程票价、按国家或地区探索目的地，并找出两机场间最便宜的出行日期。

entries.english: Personal travel agent: flights, hotels, visa checks, itineraries, travel advisories, currency conversion and card points/miles optimization.
entries.zh: 个人旅行代理：航班、酒店、签证检查、行程、旅行建议、货币转换及信用卡积分/里程优化。

entries.english: Access your SimBrief flight plans: weather (METAR/TAF/ATIS), fuel plan, weights, ATC flight plan, navlog, NOTAMs, alternates and performance analysis.
entries.zh: 访问你的 SimBrief 飞行计划：天气（METAR/TAF/ATIS）、燃油计划、重量、ATC 飞行计划、导航日志、NOTAM、备降机场和性能分析。

entries.english: Azure DevOps work items, repos, pull requests, pipelines and projects, with access modes, project allowlists, protected projects and delete confirmation.
entries.zh: Azure DevOps 工作项、仓库、拉取请求、流水线和项目，支持访问模式、项目允许列表、受保护项目及删除确认。

entries.english: Open source contribution manager: PR tracking across repos, issue discovery, CI failure diagnosis and maintainer response drafting.
entries.zh: 开源贡献管理器：跨仓库跟踪 PR、发现议题、诊断 CI 失败并起草维护者回复。

entries.english: Bitbucket Cloud pull-request review: read PRs, diffs, comments, commits and files, post inline or general comments, approve or request changes.
entries.zh: Bitbucket Cloud 拉取请求审查：读取 PR、差异、评论、提交和文件，发表行内或普通评论，批准或请求更改。

entries.english: GitHub Enterprise API integration.
entries.zh: GitHub Enterprise API 集成。

entries.english: Policy gate for agent-written code: briefs agents on repo-specific team rules and blocks commits that reintroduce documented mistakes via Git hooks and CI.
entries.zh: 代理编写代码的策略关卡：向代理说明仓库特定的团队规则，并通过 Git 钩子和 CI 阻止重新引入已记录错误的提交。

entries.english: Graph-native code repository that shows what a code change might affect before you make it.
entries.zh: 图原生代码仓库，在更改代码前展示变更可能影响的内容。

entries.english: GitHub integration for repository management, pull requests, issues and more.
entries.zh: GitHub 集成，用于管理仓库、拉取请求、议题等。

entries.english: Gitopia decentralized Git: repos, issues, PRs, labels, releases, bounties and DAO proposals, with an approval mode for human-in-the-loop.
entries.zh: Gitopia 去中心化 Git：仓库、议题、PR、标签、发布、赏金和 DAO 提案，并提供人工参与的审批模式。

entries.english: Semantic git queries: blame grouped by author, introducing PR, co-change suggestions, branch hygiene, recent-work standups and full commit context.
entries.zh: 语义 git 查询：按作者分组的 blame、引入变更的 PR、共同变更建议、分支整理、近期工作站会及完整提交上下文。

entries.english: Unofficial read/write access to the GitHub REST API, with configurable tool groups, writes off by default and typed rate-limit handling.
entries.zh: 对 GitHub REST API 的非官方读写访问，支持可配置工具组、默认关闭写入以及有类型的限流处理。

entries.english: GitLab REST API v4 coverage with meta-tools, resources and prompts, plus read-only and safe modes.
entries.zh: 覆盖 GitLab REST API v4，提供元工具、资源和提示词，以及只读和安全模式。

entries.english: Bitbucket repository management: PRs, pipelines, branches, commits, deployments, webhooks, tags, branch restrictions and source browsing.
entries.zh: Bitbucket 仓库管理：PR、流水线、分支、提交、部署、Webhook、标签、分支限制和源码浏览。

entries.english: Local Git hosting for coding agents: serve any directory as an HTTP Git remote with push events, commit statuses, secret and large-file detection and backups.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地 Git 托管：将任意目录作为 HTTP Git 远程仓库提供，支持推送事件、提交状态、密钥和大文件检测及备份。

entries.english: Local code review for you and your coding agent: the agent opens a review of its changes, you comment on lines, it replies and resolves. Reads the git worktree directly, uncommitted work included; nothing leaves your machine.
entries.zh: 供你和编程代理使用的本地代码审查：代理为其变更发起审查，你对代码行评论，它回复并解决。直接读取 git 工作树，包括未提交工作；任何内容都不会离开你的机器。

entries.english: Read-only GitHub Actions health checks: wasted CI compute costs, flaky tests from job logs, slow-run analysis and workflow linting with auto-fix previews.
entries.zh: 只读 GitHub Actions 健康检查：浪费的 CI 计算成本、从任务日志发现的不稳定测试、慢运行分析及附自动修复预览的工作流检查。

entries.english: Local safety layer for coding agents: deterministic risk checks, checkpoints and policy inspection, plus restoring files to their pre-session state.
entries.zh: 面向编程代理的本地安全层：确定性风险检查、检查点和策略检查，并可将文件恢复到会话前状态。

entries.english: Read, search and analyze local Git repositories.
entries.zh: 读取、搜索和分析本地 Git 仓库。

entries.english: Returns active decision records for a path before an agent edits it: constraints, ruled-out alternatives and warnings, stored as git trailers and notes.
entries.zh: 在代理编辑路径前返回该路径的有效决策记录：约束、已排除的替代方案和警告，存储为 git trailer 与 notes。

entries.english: GitLab CI/CD pipelines, jobs, schedules, merge requests and files, for GitLab SaaS or self-hosted instances.
entries.zh: GitLab CI/CD 流水线、任务、计划、合并请求和文件，支持 GitLab SaaS 或自托管实例。

entries.english: Selects the minimum code context needed to understand a git diff, using deterministic graph-based fragment selection under a token budget.
entries.zh: 在令牌预算内通过基于图的确定性片段选择，选取理解 git 差异所需的最少代码上下文。

entries.english: Offline root-cause analysis for coding agents: rank the commit that introduced a regression, map a feature's blast radius and verify a fix is complete.
Unofficial access to GitHub's GraphQL API for flexible queries on repository data, issues, pull requests and other resources.
Git helper for conventional commits, pre-PR secret audits and merge conflict resolution.
Manage your repositories on a Forgejo or Gitea server.
Code review against your team's written rules: a generator finds issues and an independent judge filters them, with a pre-push gate and PR bot.

Merge gate for parallel coding agents: reports conflicts git can't see between two branches (changed signatures vs new call sites, deleted-but-still-used symbols, duplicate functions) for TypeScript, JavaScript and Python, with a suggested fix per finding.
Structured Git repository analysis: project status, recent activity, code map and risk hotspots.
Line-level authorship in a shared Git checkout: multiple coding agents work in one repo, each committing only its own lines, with symbol-level claims.
Bitbucket Cloud workspaces, repos, PRs, pipelines, issues and source code, hiding tools the API key cannot use.
Branch-scoped runbooks and cross-machine verification with auditable receipts for coding agents.
Google Contacts (People API): search, create, update and delete contacts, and manage contact groups.
Google Docs API: read documents as text, structure or Markdown, and edit ranges, styles, tables and comments.
Google Forms: create and publish forms, manage questions and read responses.
Google Slides API: create and edit presentations, slides, shapes, tables and images, speaker notes and exports.
Google Tasks API: manage task lists, and create and organize tasks with due dates, notes and subtasks.
Agency OS: specialized AI roles with a real-time retro Pixel Office visualizer and a multi-provider LLM engine.

Compile agency-grade, editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations with native DrawingML vector shapes, executive KPI dashboards, and multi-format suites from Claude Desktop, Cursor, and autonomous AI agents.
