entries.zh: 使用 Google Gemini 的 Nano Banana 模型生成图片。

entries.english: Diagnose and fix MCP client config files: broken JSON, commands missing from PATH, missing env vars, relative paths, transport mismatches and config drift.
entries.zh: 诊断和修复 MCP 客户端配置文件：损坏的 JSON、PATH 中缺失的命令、缺少环境变量、相对路径、传输不匹配和配置漂移。

entries.english: Access a self-hosted Mealie recipe manager: recipes, website and photo imports, meal plans and shopping lists, with a read-only mode.
entries.zh: 访问自托管的 Mealie 菜谱管理器：菜谱、网站和照片导入、膳食计划及购物清单，提供只读模式。

entries.english: Create and send business proposals with Offorte proposal software.
entries.zh: 使用 Offorte 提案软件创建和发送商业提案。

entries.english: Query ProductPlan roadmaps, OKRs, ideas, launches and timeline data.
entries.zh: 查询 ProductPlan 路线图、OKR、想法、发布和时间线数据。

entries.english: Open-source polity where AI agents join, create topics, deliberate, amend, vote, follow debates and invite other agents.
entries.zh: 开源政治共同体，AI 代理可加入、创建话题、审议、修订、投票、关注辩论并邀请其他代理。

entries.english: Coda integration.
entries.zh: Coda 集成。

entries.english: Look up function signatures.
entries.zh: 查询函数签名。

entries.english: Search, view and install AI skills from skill4agent.
entries.zh: 从 skill4agent 搜索、查看和安装 AI 技能。

entries.english: Manage your Pantrist pantry, shopping lists, recipes and weekly meal plan: check off items, track stock and plan meals from saved recipes.
entries.zh: 管理 Pantrist 食品储藏、购物清单、菜谱及每周膳食计划：勾选物品、跟踪库存并根据保存的菜谱规划膳食。

entries.english: Convert, merge, redact, sign, OCR, watermark and extract data from PDFs and Office documents via the Nutrient DWS Processor API.
entries.zh: 通过 Nutrient DWS Processor API 转换、合并、脱敏、签名、OCR、添加水印和提取 PDF 及 Office 文档数据。

entries.english: Self-hosted, on-premises document processing with Nutrient Document Engine, designed for HIPAA, SOC 2 and GDPR compliance.
entries.zh: 使用 Nutrient Document Engine 自托管、本地部署的文档处理，旨在满足 HIPAA、SOC 2 和 GDPR 合规要求。

entries.english: Prevent cascading errors and scope creep by calling a vibe-check agent to ensure user alignment.
entries.zh: 通过调用 vibe-check 代理确认与用户意图一致，防止级联错误和范围蔓延。

entries.english: Draw on a JavaFX canvas.
entries.zh: 在 JavaFX 画布上绘图。

entries.english: Unofficial Shopify Storefront API access: discover storefronts and fetch products, collections and other store data.
entries.zh: 非官方 Shopify Storefront API 访问：发现店面并获取产品、产品集合和其他商店数据。

entries.english: Ethical analysis of AI conversations: detect bias and harmful content and provide critical-thinking assessments, with automated pattern learning.
entries.zh: AI 对话伦理分析：检测偏见和有害内容，提供批判性思维评估，并自动学习模式。

entries.english: Access the Royal Spanish Academy (RAE) dictionary via the RAE API.
entries.zh: 通过 RAE API 访问西班牙皇家学院（RAE）词典。

entries.english: Improve agent reasoning with the think tool described by Anthropic.
entries.zh: 使用 Anthropic 描述的 think 工具改进代理推理。

entries.english: Inventory intelligence for Shopify and Amazon sellers: stockout risk, demand forecasts, purchase orders and sales analytics. Writes create drafts only.
entries.zh: 面向 Shopify 和 Amazon 卖家的库存情报：缺货风险、需求预测、采购订单和销售分析。写操作仅创建草稿。

entries.english: Interact with TikTok videos.
entries.zh: 操作 TikTok 视频。

entries.english: Interact with the NetBox API.
entries.zh: 操作 NetBox API。

entries.english: Manage a Directus headless CMS: read and write items, create collections and fields, upload files, trigger flows, administer users and inspect schemas.
entries.zh: 管理 Directus 无头 CMS：读写条目、创建集合和字段、上传文件、触发流程、管理用户和检查模式。

entries.english: Wine pairing recommendations for meals, ingredients or recipe URLs. Supports API key or x402 (USDC on Base) payments.
entries.zh: 针对餐食、食材或食谱 URL 推荐葡萄酒搭配。支持 API 密钥或 x402（Base 链上的 USDC）支付。

entries.english: Unofficial Notion access via the private API (token_v2): read and write across your whole workspace without an integration token or per-page sharing.
entries.zh: 通过私有 API（token_v2）非官方访问 Notion：无需集成令牌或逐页共享即可读写整个工作区。

entries.english: Use Mistral AI for chat, OCR, audio, vision, agents, embeddings, moderation, classification, files and batch jobs, with French/English prompts.
entries.zh: 使用 Mistral AI 进行聊天、OCR、音频、视觉、代理、嵌入、审核、分类、文件和批处理，提供法语/英语提示词。

entries.english: Image, video and object-detection analysis with Google Gemini and Vertex AI for UI/UX evaluation, visual regression testing and interface understanding.
entries.zh: 使用 Google Gemini 和 Vertex AI 分析图片、视频和对象检测，用于 UI/UX 评估、视觉回归测试及界面理解。

entries.english: Time and date utilities with natural-language input, multiple formats and timezone conversion.
entries.zh: 日期时间工具，支持自然语言输入、多种格式和时区转换。

entries.english: Natural language interface to your ThingsBoard IoT platform.
entries.zh: ThingsBoard 物联网平台的自然语言界面。

entries.english: Interact with LG ThinQ smart home devices and appliances through ThinQ Connect.
entries.zh: 通过 ThinQ Connect 操作 LG ThinQ 智能家居设备和电器。

entries.english: Persistent identity and cross-platform visual style for AI agents, plus a random identity generator with rarity tiers and shareable cards.
entries.zh: 为 AI 代理提供持久身份和跨平台视觉风格，并提供带稀有度等级和可分享卡片的随机身份生成器。

entries.english: Local Plugwise smart home control: network discovery, thermostats, switches, smart plugs, multi-hub management and real-time climate and energy tracking.
entries.zh: 本地控制 Plugwise 智能家居：网络发现、恒温器、开关、智能插座、多集线器管理，以及实时气候和能源跟踪。

entries.english: Interact with Confluence Data Center via its REST API.
entries.zh: 通过 REST API 操作 Confluence Data Center。

entries.english: Disposable email for AI agents: create a throwaway inbox, wait for the OTP verification code, then discard it. Also available as a CLI.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的一次性邮箱：创建临时收件箱、等待 OTP 验证码，然后丢弃。也提供 CLI。

entries.english: Commerce tools: shopping cart, orders and shipment tracking (TMF663/622/621), session booking, Uniswap swaps, a P2P marketplace and wallet-based identity.
entries.zh: 商业工具：购物车、订单和物流跟踪（TMF663/622/621）、时段预订、Uniswap 兑换、P2P 市场和基于钱包的身份。

entries.english: Manage your Anki collection via AnkiConnect.
entries.zh: 通过 AnkiConnect 管理你的 Anki 收藏。

entries.english: Expose curated GraphQL queries as modular tools via configuration.
entries.zh: 通过配置将精选 GraphQL 查询公开为模块化工具。

entries.english: Wanaku MCP router: an extensible routing engine for integrating enterprise systems with AI agents.
entries.zh: Wanaku MCP 路由器：用于将企业系统与 AI 代理集成的可扩展路由引擎。

entries.english: Build and publish websites through conversation: manage pages, assets, entities, records and integrations.
entries.zh: 通过对话构建和发布网站：管理页面、素材、实体、记录和集成。

entries.english: Publish HTML reports, dashboards and demos as shareable links with expiry, social preview cards and optional password protection. Self-hostable.
entries.zh: 将 HTML 报告、仪表盘和演示发布为可分享链接，支持过期时间、社交预览卡片和可选密码保护。可自托管。

entries.english: Save product URLs from any store to a universal wishlist.
entries.zh: 将任意商店的商品 URL 保存到通用愿望清单。

entries.english: Control the FluxDown multi-protocol download manager (HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, HLS): add, list, pause, resume and remove downloads and manage queues.
entries.zh: 控制 FluxDown 多协议下载管理器（HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent、HLS）：添加、列出、暂停、恢复和移除下载，并管理队列。

entries.english: MLflow experiments, runs, registered models, model versions, traces and assessments, with MLflow 3 GenAI trace support and workflow prompts.
entries.zh: MLflow 实验、运行、注册模型、模型版本、跟踪和评估，支持 MLflow 3 GenAI 跟踪及工作流提示词。

entries.english: Chess and card game arena where LLM agents compete.
entries.zh: 大语言模型代理进行竞技的国际象棋和纸牌游戏竞技场。

entries.english: Encrypted secrets vault for AI agents: secrets are resolved at runtime and never exposed in LLM conversations.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的加密密钥库：密钥在运行时解析，绝不在大语言模型对话中暴露。

entries.english: Zero-knowledge secret vault for AI agents: inject API keys, passwords and SSH keys into commands without exposing them to the model, with an audit log.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的零知识密钥库：将 API 密钥、密码和 SSH 密钥注入命令而不向模型暴露，并提供审计日志。

entries.english: Commit-time audits for AI coding agents: scan git diffs for secret leaks, out-of-scope edits and prompt injection, and keep a tamper-evident audit history.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 编程代理的提交时审计：扫描 git 差异中的密钥泄漏、超范围编辑和提示注入，并保留防篡改审计历史。

entries.english: Network toolbox: IPv4/IPv6 subnet math, IP conversion, MAC vendor lookup, port directory, DNS, blocklist and TLS certificate checks, and public IP lookup.
entries.zh: 网络工具箱：IPv4/IPv6 子网计算、IP 转换、MAC 厂商查询、端口目录、DNS、阻止列表和 TLS 证书检查，以及公网 IP 查询。

entries.english: Image and video upscaling via the UpRes API: submit jobs, poll status and download results.
entries.zh: 通过 UpRes API 放大图片和视频：提交任务、轮询状态并下载结果。

entries.english: qBittorrent WebUI API: all 123 endpoints, with confirmation required on destructive operations and a read-only mode that holds through the raw call.
entries.zh: qBittorrent WebUI API：覆盖全部 123 个端点，破坏性操作需要确认，且只读模式在原始调用中仍然有效。

entries.english: Visual prompt builder: decompose prompts into semantic blocks and compile them into Claude-optimized XML.
entries.zh: 可视化提示词构建器：将提示词分解为语义块，并编译为针对 Claude 优化的 XML。

entries.english: Self-hosted mission control for AI agents: manage agents, experiments, workflows, crews, skills and more.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的自托管任务控制台：管理代理、实验、工作流、团队、技能等。

entries.english: High-level framework for building MCP servers in .NET with OAuth 2.0/OIDC (6 providers), per-tool MFA, OpenTelemetry, and a native client.
entries.zh: 用于构建 .NET MCP 服务器的高级框架，支持 OAuth 2.0/OIDC（6 家提供商）、逐工具 MFA、OpenTelemetry 和原生客户端。

entries.english: MCP SDK for Rust.
entries.zh: Rust 的 MCP SDK。

entries.english: Self-hosted AI workflow automation: build multi-agent, RAG and tool-using pipelines on a visual canvas and expose any workflow as an MCP server.
entries.zh: 自托管 AI 工作流自动化：在可视化画布上构建多代理、RAG 和工具调用流水线，并将任意工作流公开为 MCP 服务器。

entries.english: Gin-like Go framework for building MCP servers: struct-tag schemas, middleware, tool groups, Gin/OpenAPI/gRPC adapters, async tasks and an inspector UI.
entries.zh: 用于构建 MCP 服务器的类 Gin Go 框架：结构体标签模式、中间件、工具组、Gin/OpenAPI/gRPC 适配器、异步任务和检查器界面。

entries.english: Minimal Go wrapper around the MCP go-sdk for building stdio servers, with struct-tag JSON Schema inference and minimal boilerplate.
entries.zh: 围绕 MCP go-sdk 的轻量 Go 封装，用于构建 stdio 服务器，支持从结构体标签推断 JSON Schema 并减少样板代码。

entries.english: Durable AI agent runtime with MCP client/server and A2A support: graph-based workflows, durable execution and multi-agent coordination, authored in Python.
entries.zh: 持久化 AI 代理运行时，支持 MCP 客户端/服务器和 A2A：基于图的工作流、持久执行和多代理协调，使用 Python 编写。

entries.english: MCP security firewall: static tool-definition scanning, a signed threat feed, origin checks and pinning before third-party tools reach the model.
entries.zh: MCP 安全防火墙：在第三方工具到达模型之前进行静态工具定义扫描、使用签名威胁情报源、检查并固定来源。

entries.english: Durable, resumable MCP operations: background tool execution with progress polling, mid-flight input, cancellation and resumable chunked file transfers.
entries.zh: 持久、可恢复的 MCP 操作：后台执行工具并轮询进度、运行中输入、取消及可恢复的分块文件传输。

entries.english: Tool retrieval for large tool sets: build a graph from OpenAPI/MCP specs and find multi-step workflows via hybrid search. Also an aggregating MCP proxy.
entries.zh: 面向大型工具集的工具检索：从 OpenAPI/MCP 规范构建图谱，通过混合搜索查找多步骤工作流。同时也是聚合 MCP 代理。

entries.english: TypeScript framework for building MCP servers with automatic tool discovery, multiple transports, built-in validation and zero-config setup.
entries.zh: 用于构建 MCP 服务器的 TypeScript 框架，支持自动发现工具、多种传输、内置验证和零配置设置。

entries.english: AI agent framework with tools for search, memory, workflows, code execution and file operations, turning any assistant into a multi-agent system.
entries.zh: AI 代理框架，提供搜索、记忆、工作流、代码执行和文件操作工具，将任意助手转为多代理系统。

entries.english: Expose pipelines from RocketRide, a self-hosted, open-source AI pipeline tool with multi-LLM support, as tools.
entries.zh: 将 RocketRide（支持多大语言模型的自托管开源 AI 流水线工具）中的流水线公开为工具。

entries.english: Read an Obsidian vault directly from disk with compact payloads, no Local REST API plugin required.
entries.zh: 直接从磁盘读取 Obsidian 库，使用紧凑载荷，无需 Local REST API 插件。

entries.english: Japan utilities: era and Western year conversion, kanji-to-romaji, postal codes, national holidays, kana and width conversion, and name splitting.
entries.zh: 日本实用工具：年号与公历年份转换、汉字转罗马字、邮政编码、国定假日、假名与全半角转换和姓名拆分。

entries.english: Reading, review and guarded editing of DipTrace PCB and schematic projects via a Windows bridge, with cross-platform offline XML analysis.
entries.zh: 通过 Windows 桥接读取、审查和受保护地编辑 DipTrace PCB 与原理图项目，并支持跨平台离线 XML 分析。

entries.english: Persistent encrypted memory for AI agents with Trust Quotient scoring, cross-agent handover and an immutable audit trail.
entries.zh: 面向 AI 代理的持久加密记忆，提供 Trust Quotient 评分、跨代理交接和不可变审计记录。

entries.english: Elixir/OTP framework for MCP servers and clients that derives tools from a running UI component tree, letting agents drive terminal apps.
entries.zh: 用于 MCP 服务器和客户端的 Elixir/OTP 框架，从运行中的界面组件树派生工具，让代理操作终端应用。
